dialogue: Wooh, I’m all sweaty, anybody want to log on to second life and go swimming, I just built a virtual pool.

dialogue: No, I can’t look at you or your avatar right now.

dialogue: Sounds like your neighbour’s home.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Excuse me.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Don’t forget the mail you took accidentally on purpose so you’d have an excuse to talk to her.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Oh, right, right right right right.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Stealing snail mail, very old school, I like it.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Penny, the mailman did it again, he… (looks up to see Penny kissing a hunky man) Oh! Sorry.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Um, no, hi Leonard, this is Doug, Doug, this is my neighbour Leonard.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: What’s up bro.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Not much. Bro.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Is, is everything okay.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Uh, yeah, uh, I just, I got your mail again, here.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Thank you, I’ve got to talk to that mailman.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Oh no, that’s probably not such a good idea. Civil servants have a documented propensity to, you know, snap.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Okay, well, thank you, again.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: No problem. Bye. Oh, and, bye, bro! (Returns to apartment).

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Penny for your thoughts.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: What’s the matter.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: No, I’m fine. Penny’s fine, the guy she’s kissing is really fine and…

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Kissing, what kind of kissing? Cheeks? Lips? Chaste? French?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: What is wrong with you?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: I’m a romantic.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Please don’t tell me that your hopeless infatuation is devolving into pointless jealousy.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: No, I’m not jealous, I’m just a little concerned for her. I didn’t like the look of the guy that she was with.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Because he looked better than you?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Yeah. He was kinda dreamy.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Well, at least now you can retrieve the black box from the twisted smouldering wreckage that was once your fantasy of dating her, and analyse the data so that you don’t crash into geek mountain again.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: I disagree, love is not a sprint, it’s a marathon. A relentless pursuit that only ends when she falls into your arms. Or hits you with the pepper spray.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Well, I’m done with Penny. I’m going to be more realistic and go after someone my own speed.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Like who?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: I don’t know. Olivia Geiger?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: The dietician at the cafeteria with the limp and the lazy eye?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Yeah.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Well, I don’t think you have a shot there. I have noticed that Lesley Winkle recently started shaving her legs. Now, given that winter is coming one can only assume that she is signalling sexual availability.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: I don’t know, you guys work in the same lab.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: So?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: There are pitfalls, trust me, I know. When it comes to sexual harassment law I’m… a bit of a self-taught expert.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Look, Howard, if I were to ask Lesley Winkle out it would just be for dinner, I’m not going to walk into the lab, ask her to strip naked and dance for me.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Oh, then you’re probably okay.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Howard and Lesley’s lab.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Hello Lesley.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Hi Leonard.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Lesley I would like to propose an experiment.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Goggles, Leonard.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Right. Lesley, I would like to propose an experiment.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Hang on. I’m trying to see how long it takes a five hundred kilowatt oxygen iodine laser to heat up my cup o’ noodles.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Pfff, I’ve done it, about two seconds, 2.6 for minestrone. Anyway, I was thinking more of a bio-social exploration with a neuro-chemical overlay.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Wait, are you asking me out?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: I was going to characterise it as the modification of our colleague/friendship paradigm, with the addition of a date-like component. But we don’t need to quibble over terminology.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: What sort of experiment would you propose?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: There is a generally accepted pattern in this area, I would pick you up, take you to a restaurant, then we would see a movie, probably a romantic comedy featuring the talents of Hugh Grant or Sandra Bullock.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Interesting. And would you agree that the primary way we would evaluate either the success or failure of the date would be based on the bio-chemical reaction during the goodnight kiss.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Heartrate, pheromones, etc, yes.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Well, why don’t we just stipulate that the date goes well and move to the key variable.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: You mean, kiss you now?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Yes.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Can you define the parameters of the kiss?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Closed mouth but romantic. Mint?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Thank you. (Takes mint). Shall I count down from three?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: No, I think it needs to be spontaneous.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: What do you think.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: You proposed the experiment, I think you should present your findings first.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Fair enough. On the plus side, it was a good kiss, reasonable technique, no extraneous spittle. On the other hand, no arousal.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: None?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: None.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Ah. Well, thank you for your time.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Thank you.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: None at all?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Sheldon and Leonard’s flat. Sheldon, Raj and Howard are playing Jenga.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Sheldon, if you were a robot, and I knew and you didn’t, would you want me to tell you?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: That depends. When I learn that I’m a robot, will I be able to handle it?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Maybe, although the history of science-fiction is not on your side.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Uh, let me ask you this. When I learn that I’m a robot, would I be bound by Asimov’s three laws of robotics?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: You might be bound by them right now.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: That’s true. Have you ever harmed a human being, or through inaction allowed a human being to come to harm?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Of course not.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Have you ever harmed yourself, or allowed yourself to be harmed except in cases where a human being would have been endangered?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Well, no.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: I smell robot.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Hey, what’s going on.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: The internet’s been down for half an hour.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Also, Sheldon may be a robot.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: So, how did it go with Lesley?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Oh, we tried kissing, but the earth didn’t move. I mean any more than the 383 miles that it was going to move anyway.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Oh, I’ve seen that look before. This is just going to be two weeks of moping and tedious emo songs, and calling me to come down to pet stores to look at cats. I don’t know if I can take it.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: You could power down.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Well, as usual, Wolowitz has the solution. I happen to know a place where there are plenty of eligible women, and Leonard could have his pick.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: A salsa class. The four guys and a random fat bloke salsa opposite five middle-aged women.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Remember the Latin hips. Shoulders stay still, and we sway. One two three. Five six seven.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: I think Mrs Tishman’s got her eye on you. I’ve been there, you’re in for a treat.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: The flat, Leonard is entering, singing to himself a depressing emo song.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Oh, good lord.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: You don’t know me, you don’t wear my chains… God, that’s a good song.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: If you’re compiling a mix CD for a double suicide. (Leonard is taking supplies out of a bag) Oh, I hope that scratching post is for you.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: I know what you’re thinking, I’ve taken your asthma into account. There’s a feline geneticist in San Diego who has developed the cutest little hypo-allergenic calicos.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Leonard, listen to me…

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: I’ve been thinking about names, I’m kind of torn between Einstein, Newton and Sergeant Fuzzyboots.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Leonard, do you really think you can satisfy your need for a relationship with a genetically altered cat?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Maybe, if it’s a cute little cuddly cat.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Oh, come on, Leonard! This is obviously about Penny.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: It doesn’t matter. The woman’s not interested in me, the woman rejected me.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Okay, look, I think that you have as much of a chance of having a sexual relationship with Penny as the Hubble Telescope does of discovering at the centre of every black hole is a little man with a flashlight searching for a circuit breaker. Nevertheless, I do feel obligated to point out to you that she did no reject you. You did not ask her out.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: You’re right. I didn’t ask her out, I should ask her out.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: No. No, now that was not my point. My point was, don’t buy a cat.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: No, but you’re right. I should march over there and ask her out.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Oh, goody, we’re getting a cat.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: The hallway. Leonard knocks on Penny’s door.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Ah, hey Leonard.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Good afternoon Penny, so hi, hey. Uh… I was wondering if you had plans for dinner.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Uh, do you mean dinner tonight?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: There is an inherent ambiguity in the word dinner. Technically it refers to the largest meal of the day whenever it is consumed, so, to clarify here, by dinner I mean supper.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Supper?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Or dinner. I was thinking six thirty, if you can go, or a different time.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Uh, six thirty’s great.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Really? Great!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Yeah, I like hanging out with you guys.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Us guys?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: You know, Sheldon, Howard, Raj, who all’s coming?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: They…. might all be there. Or a subset of them might be there, uh, algebraically speaking there are too many unknowns, for example Sheldon had Quizznos for lunch, sometimes he finds that filling, other times he doesn’t, it’s no fault of Quizznos, they have a varied menu.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Okay, whatever, it sounds like fun.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Great. Did we say a time?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Six thirty.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: And that’s still good for you.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: It’s fine.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Cos it’s not carved in stone.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: No, six thirty’s great.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: I’ll get my chisel.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Why?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: To… carve the… okay, I’ll see you six thirty.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Sheldon and Leonard’s apartment. Leonard enters from bedrooms, dressed in a smart shirt and trousers. They are covered in sweat stains.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: How do I look?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Could you be more specific?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Can you tell I’m perspiring a little?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: No. The dark crescent-shaped patterns under your arms conceal it nicely. What time is your date?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Six thirty.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Perfect, that gives you two hours and fifteen minutes for that dense molecular cloud of Aramis to dissipate.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Is it too much?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Not if you’re a rugby team.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: By the way, if it should ever come up, you didn’t join us because you stuffed yourself with a chicken carbonara sub at Quizznos.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Why would I join you?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: No reason. Oh, you know what, maybe this isn’t such a good idea.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Oh, no, no, no, well now, there’s always the possibility that alcohol and poor judgement on her part might lead to a nice romantic evening.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: You’re right, alcohol, poor judgement, it could go well.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Of course, there’s the other possibility that this date kicks off a rather unpleasant six months of the two of you passing awkwardly in the hall until one of you breaks down and moves to another zip code.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: You could have stopped at “it could go well.”

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: If I could of, I would of.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: I mean, I’m a perfectly nice guy. There’s no reason we couldn’t go to the restaurant and have a lovely dinner. Maybe take a walk afterwards, talk about things we have in common, “you love pottery? I love pottery!” You know, there’s a pause, we both know what’s happening, I lean in, we kiss, it’s a little tentative at first but then I realise, she’s kissing me back, and she’s biting my lower lip, you know, she wants me, this thing is going the distance, we’re going to have sex! Oh God! Oh, my God!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Is the sex starting now?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: I’m having a panic attack.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Oh, okay, well then, calm down.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: If I could calm down I wouldn’t be having a panic attack, that’s why they call it a panic attack.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Alright, alright, well, just, sit down, yes, sit down, now close your eyes.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Why?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Just do it.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Okay.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Now try to increase your alpha-wave activity.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: What?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: It’s a bio-feedback technique, it’s relaxation through brain-wave manipulation, I read a paper about it in the Journal of American Neuroscience, it was a little sparsely sourced but I think the basic science is valid, I probably have it here somewhere.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Oh, who am I kidding, I can’t go through with this, you need to call her and cancel.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Me?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Yes.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: What should I tell her.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: I don’t know. Tell her I’m sick.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Okay.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Not the kind of illness that will make her want to come over and take care of me, but nothing so critical that she’ll feel uncomfortable going out with me in the future if I want to try this again.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Got it. So I’m assuming nothing venereal. I’ll just tell her that you had a routine colonoscopy and haven’t quite bounced back.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Give me the phone.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: But I thought you wanted to cancel?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: I can’t because if I don’t show up she’ll still be expecting you.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Why would she be expecting me?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Stop asking me all these questions, I need to take another shower.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: A restaurant.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: So are the rest of the guys meeting us here?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Oh, yeah, no. Turns out that Raj and Howard had to work, and Sheldon had a colonoscopy and he hasn’t quite bounced back yet.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Ooh, my uncle just had a colonoscopy.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: You’re kidding, well, then, that’s something we have in common.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: How?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: We both have people in our lives who… want to nip intestinal polyps in the bud.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: So, what’s new in the world of physics?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Nothing.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Really, nothing?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Well, with the exception of string theory, not much has happened since the 1930’s, and you can’t prove string theory, at best you can say “hey, look, my idea has an internal logical consistency.”

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Ah. Well I’m sure things will pick up.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: What’s new at the Cheesecake Factory?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Oh, uh, not much. We do have a chocolate key lime that’s moving pretty well.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Good. Good. And what about your, uh, hallway friend.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Doug? Oh, yeah, I dunno, I mean, he’s nice and funny, but…

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Can I get you started with some drinks?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: No, (waves her away) You were saying, but…

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: I’d like a drink.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Just say the but thing about Doug and then I’ll get her back.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Okay, well, you know, it’s just me. I’m still getting over this break-up with Kurt, and this thing with Doug would be just rebound sex.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Ugh, don’t get me started on rebound sex.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: It’s just, it’s my pattern. I break up, then I find some cute guy, and then it’s just thirty six meaningless of… well, you know.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: I’m not sure that I do. Um, is that one thirty-six hour experience, or is it thirty six hours spread out over say, one… glorious summer.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: No, it’s usually over a weekend, and trust me, you do not feel good after it.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Well, chafing, right?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Emotionally.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Of course, yeah, emotional chafing. Hey, do you want to see something cool? (Penny nods.) I can make this olive go into this glass without touching it.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: How?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Physics. (He places the glass over the olive and spins it until the olive gets caught up on the side).

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Wow, centrifugal force!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Actually, it’s centripetal force, which is an inward force generated by the glass acting on the olive. (The olive drops.) Excuse me. (Leonard disappears under table.)Now, if you were riding on the olive, you’d be in a non-inertial reference frame, and would (he bangs his head on the underside of the table.)

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Are you okay?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Yeah, I’m okay. Did you spill ketchup?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: No.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: I’m not okay.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: The stairwell of the apartment building.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Are you sure you don’t want to go to the emergency room?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: No, no, I’m okay, it’s stopped bleeding.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: I know, but you did throw up. Isn’t that a sign of a concussion?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Yes, but I get car sick too, so…

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Okay.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Sorry about your car, by the way.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Oh, no, it’s fine, you got most of it out the window.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: The poor guy on the bike. I had a nice time.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Yeah, me too. Um, good night. (Leonard turns across hallway.) Leonard?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Yeah.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Was this supposed to be a date?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: This? No. No, of course not, this was just you and me hanging out with a bunch of guys who didn’t show up, because of work and a colonoscopy.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Okay, I was just checking.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: When I take a girl out on a date, and I do, she knows she’s been dated. Capital D. Bold face, underline, like Day-ted. I think I might have a little concussion, I’m going to go lay down for a while, good night.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: The apartment, Leonard enters.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: So, how was your date?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Awesome!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Score one for liquor and poor judgement.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Bill Prady & Steven Molaro

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 03 – The Fuzzy Boots Corollary
dialogue: Chuck Lorre

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Sheldon and Leonard’s apartment.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: I’ve been thinking about time travel again.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Why, did you hit a roadblock with invisibility?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Put it on the back burner. Anyway, it occurs to me, if I ever did perfect a time machine, I’d just go into the past and give it to myself, thus eliminating the need for me to invent it in the first place.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Interesting.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Yeah, it really takes the pressure off.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Sounds like a breakthrough, should I call the science magazines and tell them to hold the front cover? (Exiting the apartment.)

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: It’s time travel, Leonard, I will have already done that.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Then I guess congratulations are in order.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: No, congratulations will have been in order. You know, I’m not going to enjoy this party.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: I know, I’m familiar with you.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: At the last department party, Dr Finkleday cornered me and talked about spelunking for 45 minutes.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Yes, I was there.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: You know what’s interesting about caves, Leonard?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: What?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Nothing.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Well then we’ll avoid Finkleday, we’ll meet the new department head, congratulate him, shake his hand and go.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: How’s this? Pleased to meet you, Dr Gablehouser. How fortunate for you that the University has chosen to hire you, despite the fact that you’ve done no original research in 25 years, and instead have written a series of popular books that reduce the great concepts of science to a series of anecdotes, each one dumbed down to accommodate the duration of an average bowel movement. Mahalo.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Mahalo’s a nice touch.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Do you know there are only eight consonants in the Hawaiian language.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Interesting, you should lead with that.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: The department party. Sheldon, Raj and Leonard are at the buffet table.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Oh, God, Look at this buffet. I love America.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: You don’t have buffets in India?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Of course, but it’s all Indian food. You can’t find a bagel in Mumbai to save your life. Schmear me.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Well here’s an interesting turn of events.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: What. (Sees Howard entering with a statuesque blonde) Howard brought a date?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: A more plausible explanation is that his work in robotics has made an amazing leap forward.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Hey, what up, science bitches? May I introduce my special lady friend, Summer. (Puts arm around her.)

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: I already told you, touching’s extra.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Right. Sorry.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Here comes our new boss, be polite.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Hi fellas, Eric Gablehouser.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Howard Wolowitz.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Howard, nice to meet you, and you are?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: An actual real scientist. (To Leonard) How was that?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: The stairwell of the apartment building. Sheldon is carrying a box of his things.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: I can’t believe he fired me.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Well, you did call him a glorified high-school science teacher whose last successful experiment was lighting his own farts.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: In my defence, I prefaced that by saying “with all due respect.”

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: The apartment, Sheldon is in the kitchen cooking, Leonard enters.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Morning

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Morning.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: You’re making eggs for breakfast?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: This isn’t breakfast, it’s an experiment.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Huh? Cos it looks a lot like breakfast.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: I finally have the time to test my hypothesis, about the separation of the water molecules from the egg proteins, and its impact vis-a-vis taste.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Sounds yummy. I look forward to your work with bacon.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: As do I.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: You know, I’m sure if you just apologised to Gablehauser he would give you your job back.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: I don’t want my job back. I’ve spent the last three and a half years staring at greaseboards full of equations. Before that I spent four years working on my thesis. Before that I was in college, and before that, I was in the fifth grade. This is my first day off in decades, and I’m going to savour it.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Okay. I’ll let you get back to fixing your eggs.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: I’m not just fixing my eggs, I’m fixing everyone’s eggs.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: And we all thank you.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Use new eggs. (There is a knock on the door).

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Hi, hey. I’m running out to the market, do you guys need anything?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Oh, well this would be one of those circumstances that people unfamiliar with the law of large numbers would call a coincidence.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: I’m sorry?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: I need eggs. Four dozen should suffice.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Four dozen?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Yes, and evenly distributed amongst brown, white, free range, large, extra-large and jumbo.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Okay, one more time?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Never mind, you won’t get it right, I’d better come with you.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Oh, yay!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Penny’s car

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: How come you didn’t go into work today.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: I’m taking a sabbatical, because I won’t kow-tow to mediocre minds.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: So you got canned, huh?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Theoretical physicists do not get canned. But yeah.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Well, maybe it’s all for the best, you know I always say, when one door closes, another one opens.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: No it doesn’t. Not unless the two doors are connected by relays, or there are motion sensors involved.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: No, no, I meant…

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Or the first door closing causes a change of air pressure that acts upon the second door.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Never mind.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Slow down. Slow down, please slow down.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: We’re fine.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Look, you’re not leaving yourself enough space between cars.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Oh, sure I am.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: No, no. Let me do the math for you, this car weighs let’s say 4,000lb, now add say 140 for me, 120 for you.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Oh, I’m sorry, did I insult you? Is your body mass somehow tied into your self worth?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Well, yeah.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Interesting. Anyway, that gives us a total weight of, let’s say, 4,400lb.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Let’s say 4,390.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Fine. We’re travelling forward at, good Lord, 51 miles an hour. Now let’s assume that your brakes are new and the callipers are aligned, still, by the time we come to a stop, we’ll be occupying the same space as that Buick in front of us, an impossibility that nature will quickly resolve into death, mutilation and… oh look, they built a new put-put course.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: The supermarket.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: This is great. Look at me, out in the real world of ordinary people, just living their ordinary, colourless, workaday lives.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Thank you.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: No, thank you. And thank you, ordinary person. Hey, you want to hear an interesting thing about tomatoes.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Uh, no, no not really. Listen, didn’t you say you needed some eggs.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Uh, yes, but anyone who knows anything about the dynamics of bacterial growth knows to pick up their refrigerated foods on the way out of the supermarket.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Oh, okay, well maybe you should start heading on out then.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: No, this is fun. Oh, the thing about tomatoes, and I think you’ll really enjoy this, is, they’re shelved with the vegetables, but they’re technically a fruit.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Interesting.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Isn’t it?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: No, I mean what you find enjoyable.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Oh boy.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: What now?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Well, there’s some value to taking a multivitamin, but the human body can only absorb so much, what you’re buying here are the ingredients for very expensive urine.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Well, maybe that’s what I was going for.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Well then you’ll want some manganese.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: On the stairwell of the apartment building.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: That was fun. Maybe tomorrow we can go to one of those big warehouse stores.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Oh, I don’t know Sheldon, it’s going to take me a while to recover from all the fun I had today.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Are you sure. There are a lot of advantages to buying in bulk. For example, I noticed that you purchase your tampons one month’s supply at a time.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: What?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Well think about it, it’s a product that doesn’t spoil, and you’re going to be needing them for at least the next thirty years.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: You want me to buy thirty years worth of tampons?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Well, thirty, thirty five, hey, when did your mother go into menopause?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Okay, I’m not talking about this with you.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Oh, Penny, this is a natural human process, and we’re talking about statistically significant savings. Now, if you assume 15 tampons per cycle and a 28 day cycle, are you fairly regular? (Penny shuts door in his face.) Okay, no warehouse store, but we’re still on for put-put golf, right?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: The apartment, Sheldon has several bowls containing goldfish.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Hey, I just ran into Penny, she seemed upset about something.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: I think it’s her time of the month. I marked the calendar for future reference.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: What’s with the fish?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: It’s an experiment.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: What happened to your scrambled egg research?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Oh, that was a dead end. Scrambled eggs are as good as they’re ever going to be.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: So… fish.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: I read an article about Japanese scientists, who inserted DNA from luminous jellyfish into other animals, and I thought hey, fish nightlights.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Fish nightlights.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: It’s a billion dollar idea. Shhhhh!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Mum’s the word. Sheldon, are you sure you don’t want to just apologise to Gablehauser and get your job back.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Oh, no, no, no. No, I’ve too much to do.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Like luminous fish.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Shhhhh!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Right… I didn’t….

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: That’s just the beginning. I also have an idea for a bulk mail-order feminine hygiene company. Oh, glow in the dark tampons! Leonard, we’re going to be rich.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: The stairwell of the apartment building.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Thank you for coming on such short notice.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: You did the right thing calling.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: I didn’t know what else to do, he’s lost all focus, every day he’s got a new obsession. (They enter the apartment. Sheldon is weaving on a loom. He is wrapped in a poncho.) This is a particularly disturbing one.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Mommy.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Hi baby.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: You called my mother?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Oh, you got yourself a loom, how nice.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Thank you.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Honey, why did you get a loom?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: I was working with luminous fish, and I thought, hey, loom! Mom, what are you doing here?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Leonard called me.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: I know, but why?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Because one of the great minds of the twenty-first century is raising glow-in-the-dark fish and weaving sarapes.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: This is not a sarape. This is a poncho. A sarape is open at the sides, a poncho is closed, this is a poncho, and neither is a reason to call someone’s mother.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Really, when was the last time you left the house.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: I went to the market with Penny.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: That was three weeks ago.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Well then buckle up, in the next four to eight days she’s going to get very crabby.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Sweetheart, your little friend is concerned about you.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Yes, well I’m not a child, I’m a grown man capable of living my life as I see fit. And I certainly don’t need someone telling on me to my mother.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Where are you going?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: To my room, and no-one’s allowed in.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: He gets his temper from his daddy.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Oh.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: He’s got my eyes.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: I see.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: All that science stuff, that comes from Jesus.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Everyone but Sheldon is in the kitchen of the apartment.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Sheldon? Your mum made dinner.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: I’m not hungry.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Oh, Leonard, don’t trouble yourself, he’s stubborn. He may stay in there ‘til the Rapture.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Are we so sure that’s a bad thing?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: I’ll tell ya, I love the boy to death, but he has been difficult since he fell out of me at the K-Mart.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Excuse me for being so bold, but I now see where Sheldon gets his smouldering good looks.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Oh, honey that ain’t going to work, but you keep trying. (To Raj) I made chicken, I hope that isn’t one of the animals that you people think is magic? You know, we have an Indian gentleman at our church, a Dr Patel, it’s a beautiful story, the lord spoke to him, and moved him to give us all 20% off on lasic, you know, those that needed it.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: That is a lovely story, um, are we going to do anything about Sheldon?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Oh, we will, you have to take your time with Sheldon. His father, God rest his soul, used to say to me, Mary, you have to take your time with Sheldon.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Sounds like a wise man.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 04 – The Luminous Fish Effect
dialogue: Oh, not so wise, he was trying to fight a bobcat for some licquorish. So, everybody grab a plate, and a pretty place mat that Shelly wove.

dialogue: Chuck Lorre & Bill Prady
The Cheesecake Factory
Alright, I’m moving my infantry division, augmented by a battalion of Orcs from Lord of the Rings, we flank the Tennessee Volunteers, and the North once again wins the Battle of Gettysburg.
Not so fast, remember the South still has two infantry divisions, plus Superman and Godzilla.
No, no, no, no, Orcs are magic, Superman is vulnerable to magic, not to mention, you already lost Godzilla to the Illinois Cavalry and Hulk.
Why don’t you just have Robert E. Lee charge the line with Shiva and Ganesh.
Hi, you guys ready to order?
Hang on, honey. Shiva and Ganesh? The Hindu Gods against the entire Union army?
And Orcs!
I’ll be back.
Excuse me, Ganesh is the remover of obstacles, and Shiva is the destroyer. When the smoke clears, Abraham Lincoln will be speaking Hindi and drinking mint juleps.
Alright, my boss says you either have to order, or leave and never come back.
What do you recommend for someone who worked up a man-sized appetite from a morning of weight training and cardio-funk?
A shower.
I’ll take the heart smart platter.
Alright, thank you, and Sheldon.
We don’t eat here, I don’t know what’s good.
Well, it’s all good.
Statistically unlikely.
Just get a hamburger, you like hamburgers.
I like the hamburgers where we usually have hamburgers, you can’t make the assumption that I’ll like the hamburgers here.
I’m sorry. Give him a hamburger.
Uh, which one, the Classic Burger, the Ranch House Burger, the Barbecue Burger or the Kobe burger?
Can’t we just go to Big Boy? They only have one burger. The Big Boy.
The Barbecue Burger is like the Big Boy.
Excuse me, in a world that already includes the Big Boy, why would I settle for something like a Big Boy?
Because you are not at Big Boy!
Fine, I’ll have the Barbecue Burger.
Make it two.
Waitresses don’t yell at you at Big Boy.
Hey Leonard, hi guys.
Hey Lesley.
I didn’t know you ate here.
We don’t. This is a disturbing aberration.
Lesley, this is Penny, she lives across the hall from Sheldon and me.
And walks in quiet beauty like the night.
Howard, I’ve asked you not to do that.
Lesley and I do research together at the University.
Oh, wow, a girl scientist.
Yep, come for the breasts, stay for the brains. So, I’m glad I ran into you, the physics department string quartet needs a new cellist.
What happened to Elliot Wong?
He switched over to high energy radiation research, had a little mishap, and now the other guys are uncomfortable sitting next to him. So, are you in?
Yeah, sure, why not.
Great, we rehearse on Tuesdays at your place.
Why at my place?
Yeah, the department of energy said our regular space is kind of a hot zone. Nice meeting you.
Yeah, you too. Leonard, I didn’t know you played the cello?
Yeah, my parents felt that naming me Leonard and putting me in advanced placement classes wasn’t getting me beaten up enough.
If you’re into music, I happen to be a human beatbox.
Really? (Howard performs some of the worst beatboxing imaginable.) I’m actually not that into music. So hey, your friend’s really cute, anything going on with you two.
Lesley? No, no-oh, what are you kidding?
He asked her out once, it was an embarrassing failure.
Thank you Sheldon.
Oh, I’m sorry, was that supposed to be a secret?
Oh, that’s too bad, you guys would make a cute couple.
Oh dear.
What’s the matter?
She didn’t take my order.
How can she take your order when you’re too neurotic to talk to her.
Nevertheless, this will be reflected in her tip.
The stairwell of the apartment building.
What did Penny mean, you’d make a cute couple?

Well I assume she meant that the two of you together would constitute a couple that others might consider cute. An alternate, and somewhat less likely interpretation, is that you could manufacture one. As in, oh look, Leonard and Lesley made Mr and Mrs Goldfarb, aren’t they adorable.

If Penny didn’t know that Lesley had already turned me down then that would unambiguously mean that she, Penny, thought that I should her, Lesley, out, indicating that she, Penny, had no interest in me asking her, Penny, out. But because she did know that I had asked Lesley out and that she, Lesley, had turned me down then she, Penny, could be offering consolation. That’s too bad, you would have made a cute couple. But while thinking, good, Leonard remains available.
You’re a lucky man, Leonard.
How so?
You’re talking to one of the three men in the Western hemisphere capable of following that train of thought.
Well, what do you think.
I said I could follow it, I didn’t say I cared.
The apartment living room. The string quartet are practising.
I admire your fingering.
Thank you.
Maybe some time you can try that on my instrument.
Goodnight guys, good job.
Thanks.
See you next week.
That was fun, Lesley, thanks for including me.
You’re welcome. If you’re up for it we could practise that middle section again.
Uh, sure, why not.
Just so we’re clear, you understand that me hanging back to practise with you is a pretext for letting you know that I’m sexually available.
Really?
Yeah, I’m good to go.
I thought you weren’t interested in me.
That was before I saw you handling that beautiful piece of wood between your legs.
You mean my cello?
No, I mean the obvious crude double entendre. I’m seducing you.
No kidding?
What can I say, I’m a passionate and impulsive woman. So how about it?
Gee, uh…
Is it the waitress?
Penny? What about her?
Well, I thought I saw your pupils dilate when you looked at her, which, unless you’re a heroin addict, points to sexual attraction.
Well, I did have a poppy seed bagel for breakfast, which could give a positive urine test for opiates but certainly not dilate my pupils, so I guess there’s no point in bringing it up.
You and the waitress then?
No. No, there’s nothing going on between Penny and me.
So, you’re open to a sexual relationship?
Yeah. Yeah, I guess I am.
Good.
Yeah, yeah it is good. Did you want to start now?
Why don’t we finish the section first.
Oh. Okay. A little musical foreplay. Terrific.
I’m good, I’m good to go.
Me too. (Exit in direction of bedrooms.)
The hallway, Sheldon scuttles out of apartment door and crosses to Penny’s. Knocks on it urgently.
Oh, hey Sheldon, what’s going on?
I need your opinion on a matter of semiotics.
I’m sorry?
Semiotics. The study of signs and symbols, it’s a branch of philosophy related to linguistics.
Okay, sweetie, I know you think you’re explaining yourself, but you’re really not.
Just come with me.
Well?
Well what?
What does it mean?
Oh, come on, you went to college.
Yes, but I was eleven.
Alright, look, a tie on the doorknob usually means someone doesn’t want to be disturbed because they’re, you know, getting busy.
So you’re saying Leonard has a girl in there.
Well, either that or he’s lost his tie rack and gotten really into Bryan Adams.
Oh Leonard, you magnificent beast.
We really shouldn’t be standing here.
This is very awkward.
Oh, come on, you know, Leonard’s had girls over before, right?
Oh, yes, but there’s usually planning, courtship and advance notice. Last time I was able to book a cruise to the Arctic to see a solar eclipse.
Wait, you had to leave the state because your roommate was having sex?
I didn’t have to, the dates just happened to coincide.
So, do you know who’s in there?
Well, there’s Leonard. (Picking up violin case) And he’s either with Lesley Winkle or a 1930’s gangster.
Hmmm. Good for him. Good for Leonard. Okay, night.
No, no, wait, hold on.
What’s the matter?
I don’t know what the protocol is here. Do I stay, do I leave? Do I wait to greet them with a refreshing beverage?
Gee, Sheldon, you’re asking the wrong girl. I’m usually on the other side of the tie.
Hi, Leonard. It’s me, Sheldon. In the living room. I just, I wanted you to know I saw the tie. Message received. You’re welcome. You carry on. Give my best to Lesley.
In Leonard’s Bedroom. Leonard wakes up next to Lesley, puts on glasses and grins.
Living room, Sheldon is sleeping on the sofa, with his head on Lesley’s Violin case.
Big boy! (Wakes up, looks at watch, wraps self in blanket, walks towards kitchen) Someone touched my board. Oh God, my board. Leonard! Leonard!
Hey, what’s the matter?
My equations, someone’s tampered with my equations.
Are you sure?
Of course I’m sure. Look at the beta-function of quantum chrono-dynamics, the sign’s been changed.
Oh yeah. But doesn’t that fix the problem you’ve been having?
Are you insane? Are you out of your mind? Are you…. hey look, that fixes the problem I’ve been having.
You’re welcome.
You did this?
Yeah, I noticed it when I got up to get a glass of water, so I fixed it, now you can show that quarks are asymptotically free at high energies. Pretty cool, huh?
Cool?
Listen, I got to hit the lab. Thanks for a great night.
Thank you, I’ll see you at work.
Uh-duh, hold on, hold on!
What?
Who told you you could touch my board?
No-one.
I don’t come into your house and touch your board.
There are no incorrect equations on my board.
Oh, that is so… so…
I’m sorry, I’ve got to run, if you come up with an adjective, text me. (Leaves).
Inconsiderate, that is the adjective, inconsiderate.
The hallway.
You can stare at your board all day Sheldon, she’s still going to be right.
I’m not staring, I’m mulling.
Oh, hey Leonard.
Oh, hi.
So, how’s it going?
Pretty good.
Just pretty good, I’d think you were doing very good.
Pretty, very, there’s really no objective scale for delineating variations of good, why do you ask?
Well, a little bird told me that you and Lesley hooked up last night.
Sheldon!
I’m coming.
So, is it serious, do you like her?
Wuh, I don’t…. th-th-th-that’s really two different questions, uh, I’m not…. Sheldon, we have to go!
Boy, you’re wound awfully tight for a man who just had sexual intercourse.
Alright, well, I’ll talk to you later, but, I am so happy for you Leonard.

Thank you. What did she mean, she’s happy for me? Is she happy because I’m seeing someone, or is she happy because she thinks that I’m happy, because anyone who cared for someone would want them to be happy, even if the reason for their happiness made the first person unhappy. You know, because the second person, though happy, is now romantically unavailable to the first person.
Do you realise I may have to share a Nobel Prize with your booty call?
You know what, I’m being ridiculous. But who cares what Penny thinks, Lesley is a terrific girl, she’s attractive, we like each other, she’s extremely intelligent.
She’s not that intelligent.
She fixed your equation.
She got lucky.
You don’t believe in luck.
I don’t have to believe in it for her to be lucky.

Regardless, I have a chance at a real relationship with Lesley, I’m not going to pass that up for some hypothetical future happiness with a woman who may or may not want me to be happy with a woman who is currently making me happy.
Leonard?
Yeah.
I still don’t care.
Leonard and Lesley’s lab.
Hey, Lesley.
Careful  Leonard, liquid nitrogen, 320 degrees below zero.
Brrrr. Why are you smashing a flash frozen banana.
Because I’ve got a bowl of Cheerios and I couldn’t find a knife.
So anyway (puts arms around her) Hello.
Uh, what are you doing?
Just extending the intimacy. Do you want to slip over to the radiation lab and share a decontamination shower?
Okay, uh, what exactly do you think’s going on between us?
I’m not sure, but I think I’m about to discover how the banana felt.

Listen, Leonard, neither of us are neuroscientists but we both understand the biochemistry of sex, I mean, dopamine in our brains is released across synapses causing pleasure. You stick electrodes in a rat’s brain, give him an orgasm button, he’ll push that thing until he starves to death.
Who wouldn’t?
Well, the only difference between us and a rat is that you can’t stick an electrode in our hypothalamus. That’s where you come in.
Yeah, well, I’m just glad to be a part of it. So what happens now?
Well, I don’t know about your sex drive, but I’m probably good till New Years.
Oh. Okay. Thank you.
Thank you!
You want to make plans for New Years.
Woah, Leonard, please, you’re smothering me.
Sorry.
Hey, look, it’s Doctor Stud!
Doctor what?
The blogosphere is a-buzzing with news of you and Lesley Winkle making eine kleine bang-bang music.
Wha… how did it get on the internet?
I put it there.
Well, how did you know about it?
A little bird told us. Apparently you are a magnificent beast.
Well, that part’s true!
The Cheesecake Factory.
You know, I think I may have misjudged this restaurant.
No kidding.
I won’t go out on a limb, but I think we may be looking at my new Tuesday hamburger.
Your old Tuesday hamburger will be so broken hearted.
Way ahead of you. I was thinking of moving Big Boy to Thursdays, and just dropping Soup Plantation.
Really?
Yeah, the name always confused me anyway, Soup Plantation. You can’t grow soup.
So, how’s everything.
Terrific, you’ll be happy to know that I plan to come here every Tuesday night for the foreseeable future.
Really, oh yay!
Who do I speak to about permanently reserving this table?
Um, I don’t know, a psychiatrist? So hey, how are things with you and Lesley?
Oh, to be honest, I don’t think it’s going to work out.
Oh, oh that’s too bad. Well hey, don’t worry, I’m sure there is someone out there who is just right for you. (Walks away smiling).
Well what did she mean by that? Was that just a generic platitude or was that a subtle bid for attention?
You know why this hamburger surpasses the Big Boy? This is a single decker hamburger whereas the Big Boy is a double decker. This has a much more satisfying meat to bun to condiment ratio.
Are you even listening to me?
Of course I’m listening. Blah blah, hopeless Penny delusion, blah blah blah.
Okay then. You know, you can grow the ingredients for soup. (Sheldon nods).

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
