episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: He’s asking if we can come as anyone from science-fiction, fantasy…

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Sure.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: What about comic-books?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Fine.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Anime?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Of course.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: TV , film, D&D, Manga, Greek Gods, Roman Gods, Norse Gods…

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Anything you want, okay? Any costume you want. Bye.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Gentlemen, to the sewing machines.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: The apartment living room. There is a knock on the door.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: I’ll get it. (He enters, wearing a Flash costume. Opens door.)

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Bjow (They stare at each other in shock.)

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Oh, no.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Oh no! (He is also wearing a Flash costume.)

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Make way for the fastest man alive. (Enters, also in a Flash costume.) Oh no!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: See, this is why I wanted to have a costume meeting.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: We all have other costumes, we can change.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Or, we could walk right behind each other all night and look like one person going really fast.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: No, no, no, it’s a boy-girl party, this Flash runs solo.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Okay, how about this, nobody gets to be The Flash, we all change, agreed?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Agreed.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: I call Frodo!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Damn!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: The same, later. Leonard is dressed as Frodo. Howard appears to be Peter Pan. There is a knock on the door.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Hey. Sorry I’m late, but my hammer got stuck in the door on the bus.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: You went with Thor?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: What? Just because I’m Indian I can’t be a Norse God? No, no, no, Raj has to be an Indian God. That’s racism. I mean, look at Wolowitz, he’s not English, but he’s dressed like Peter Pan. Sheldon(entering in a body suit featuring black and white vertical lines) is neither sound nor light, but he’s obviously the Doppler Effect.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: I’m not Peter Pan, I’m Robin Hood.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Really, because I saw Peter Pan, and you’re dressed exactly like Cathy Rigby. She was a little bigger than you, but it’s basically the same look, man.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Hey, Sheldon, there’s something I want to talk to you about before we go to the party.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: I don’t care if anybody gets it, I’m going as the Doppler Effect.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: No, it’s not…

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: If I have to, I can demonstrate. Neeeeoooowwwww!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Terrific. Um, this party is my first chance for Penny to see me in the context of her social group, and I need you not to embarrass me tonight.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Well, what exactly do you mean by embarrass you?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: For example, tonight no-one needs to know that my middle name is Leakey.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Well, there’s nothing embarrassing about that, your father worked with Lewis Leakey, a great anthropologist. It had nothing to do with your bed-wetting.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: All I’m saying is that this party is the perfect opportunity for Penny to see me as a member of her peer group. A potential close friend and… perhaps more. I don’t want to look like a dork.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: The hallway. Howard knocks on Penny’s door with his bow.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Just a heads up fellas, if anyone gets lucky I’ve got a dozen condoms in my quiver.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Oh, hey guys.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Hey, sorry we’re late.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Late? It’s 7:05.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: And you said the party starts at seven.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Well, yeah, when you start a party at seven, no-one shows up at, you know, seven.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Yes. Yes it is. Okay, well, um, come on in.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: What, are all the girls in the bathroom?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Probably, but in their own homes.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: So what time does the costume parade start?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: The parade?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Yeah, so the judges can give out the prizes for best costume, you know, most frightening, most authentic, most accurate visual representation of a scientific principle.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Oh, Sheldon, I’m sorry but there aren’t going to be any parades or judges or prizes.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: This party is just going to suck.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: No, come on, it’s going to be fun, and you all look great, I mean, look at you, Thor, and, oh, Peter Pan, that’s so cute.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Actually, Penny, he’s Rob…

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: I’m Peter Pan! And I’ve got a handful of pixie dust with your name on it.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: No you don’t. Oh, hey, what’s Sheldon supposed to be.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Oh, he’s the Doppler Effect.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Yes. It’s the apparent change in the frequency of a wave caused by relative motion between the source of the wave and the observer.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Oh, sure, I see it now, the Doppler Effect. Alright, I’ve got to shower, you guys um, make yourselves comfortable.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Okay.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: See, people get it.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Mmmm, by Odin’s beard, this is good Chex Mix.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: No thanks, peanuts, I can’t afford to swell up in these tights.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: I’m confused. If there’s no costume parade, what are we doing here?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: We’re socialising. Meeting new people.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Telepathically?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Oh hey, when did you get here, Hi!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Penny is wearing the worst Catwoman costume I have ever seen, and that includes Halle Berry’s.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: She’s not Catwoman, she’s just a generic cat.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: And that’s the kind of sloppy costuming which results from a lack of rules and competition.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Hey guys, check out the sexy nurse. I believe it’s time for me to turn my head and cough.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: What is your move?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: I’m going to use the mirror technique. She brushes her hair back, I brush my hair back, she shrugs, I shrug, subconsciously she’s thinking we’re in sync, we belong together.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Where do you get this stuff?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: You know, psychology journals, internet research, and there’s this great show on VH1 about how to pick up girls.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Oh, if only I had his confidence. I have such difficulty speaking to women. Or around women. Or at times, even effeminate men.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: If that’s a working stethoscope, maybe you’d like to hear my heart skip a beat.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: No thanks.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: No, seriously, you can, I have transient idiopathic arrhythmia.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: I  want to get to know Penny’s friends, I just, I don’t know how to talk to these people.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Well, I actually might be able to help.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: How so?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Like Jane Goodall observing the apes, I initially saw their interactions as confusing and unstructured, but patterns emerge, they have their own language if you will.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Go on.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Well, it seems that the newcomer approaches the existing group with the greeting “How wasted am I?” which is met with an approving chorus of “Dude.”

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Then what happens?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: That’s as far as I’ve gotten.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: This is ridiculous, I’m jumping in.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Good luck.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: No, you’re coming with me.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Oh, I hardly think so.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Come on.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Aren’t you afraid I’ll embarrass you?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Yes. But I need a wing-man.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Alright, but if we’re going to use flight metaphors I’m much more suited to being the guy from the FAA, analysing wreckage.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Oh, Hi!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Hi.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Hello.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: So, what are you supposed to be?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Me? I’ll give you a hint. Neeeeooooowwwww!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Uh, a choo-choo train?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Close! Neeeeeoooooowwwww!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: A brain damaged choo-choo train?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: How wasted am I? (Raj shrugs.)

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Neeeeeooooowwwwww!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: I still don’t get it.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: I’m the Doppler Effect.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Okay, if that is some sort of learning disability, I think it’s very insensitive.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Why don’t you just tell people you’re a zebra?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Well, why don’t you just tell people you’re one of the seven dwarves.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Because I’m Frodo.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Yes, well, I’m the Doppler Effect.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Oh no.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: What?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: That’s Penny’s ex-boyfriend.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: What do you suppose he’s doing here? Besides disrupting the local gravity field.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: If he were any bigger, he’d have moons orbiting him.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Oh, snap. So I guess we’ll be leaving now.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Why should we leave? For all we know, he crashed the party and Penny doesn’t even want him here. (Penny and Kurt hug).

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: You have a back-up hypothesis.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Maybe they just want to be friends.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Or maybe she wants to be friends, and he wants something more.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Then he and I are on equal ground.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Yes, but you’re much closer to it than he is.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Look, if this was 15,000 years ago, by virtue of his size and strength, Kurt would be entitled to his choice of female partners.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: And male partners. Animal partners. Large primordial eggplants, pretty much whatever tickled his fancy.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Yes, but our society has undergone a paradigm shift, in the information age, Sheldon, you and I are the alpha males. We shouldn’t have to back down.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: True. Why don’t you text him that and see if he backs down?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: No. I’m going to assert my dominance face to face.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Face to face? Are you going to wait for him to sit down, or are you going to stand on a coffee table?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Hello Penny. Hello Kurt.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Oh, hey guys. You having a good time?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Given the reaction to my costume, this party is a scathing indictment of the American education system.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: What, you’re a zebra, right?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Yet another child left behind.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: And what are you supposed to be, an Elf?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: No, I’m a Hobbit.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: What’s the difference?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Uh, a Hobbit is a mortal Halfling inhabitant of Middle Earth, whereas an Elf is an immortal tall warrior.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: So why the hell would you want to be a Hobbit?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Because he is neither tall nor immortal, and none of us could be The Flash.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Well, whatever, why don’t you go hop off on a quest, I’m talking to Penny here.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: I think we’re all talking to Penny here.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: I’m not. No offence.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Okay, maybe you didn’t hear me, go away.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Alright Kurt, be nice.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Aw, I am being nice. Right little buddy.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Kurt!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Okay, I understand your impulse to try to physically intimidate me. I mean, you can’t compete with me on an intellectual level and so you’re driven to animalistic puffery.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Are you calling me a puffy animal?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Of course not, no, he’s not, you’re not, right Leonard?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: No, I said animalistic. Of course we’re all animals, but some of us have climbed a little higher on the evolutionary tree.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: If he understands that, you’re in trouble.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: So what, I’m unevolved?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: You’re in trouble.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: You know, you use a lot of big words for such a little dwarf.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Okay, Kurt, please.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: No, Penny, it’s okay, I can handle this. I’m not a dwarf, I’m a Hobbit. A Hobbit. Are misfiring neurons in your hippocampus preventing the conversion from short-term to long-term memory?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Okay, now you’re starting to make me mad.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: A homo-habilus discovering his opposable thumbs says what?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: What?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: I think I’ve made my point.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Yeah, how about I make a point out of your pointy little head.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Let me remind you, while my moral support is absolute, in a physical confrontation I will be less than useless.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: There’s not going to be a confrontation, in fact I doubt if he can even spell confrontation.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: C – O – N… frontation!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Kurt, put him down this instant.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: He started it.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: I don’t care, I’m finishing it, put him down.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Fine. You’re one lucky little leprechaun.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: He’s a Hobbit! I’ve got your back.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Leonard, are you okay.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Yeah, no, I’m fine. It’s good, it’s a good party, thanks for having us, it’s just getting a little late so….

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Oh, okay, alright, well thank you for coming.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Happy Halloween. (They leave) If it’s any consolation, I thought that homo-habilus line really put him in his place.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: The living room. Sheldon brings Leonard a cup of tea.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: What’s that?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Tea. When people are upset the cultural convention is to bring them hot beverages. There there. You want to talk about it?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: No.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Good. There there was really all I had.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Good night Sheldon.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Good night Leonard.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Hey Leonard.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Hi Penny.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Hey, I just wanted to make sure you’re okay.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: I’m fine.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: I’m so sorry about what happened.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: It’s not your fault.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Yes it is. That’s why I broke up with him, he always does stuff like that.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: So why was he at your party?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Well, I ran into him last week and, he was…  just, all apologetic, about how he’s changed, he was just going on and on and I believed him, and I’m an idiot because I always believe guys like that and… I can’t go back to my party because he’s there, and I know you don’t want to hear this and I’m upset and I’m really drunk and I just want to… (bursts into tears and rests head on Leonard’s shoulder.)

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: There there.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: God, what is wrong with me.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Nothing, you’re perfect.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Gah, I’m not perfect.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Yes you are.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: You really think so, don’t you? (She kisses hm.)

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Penny?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Yeah.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: How much have you had to drink tonight?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Just…. a lot.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Are you sure that your being drunk, and your being angry with Kurt doesn’t have something to do with what’s going on here?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: It might. Boy, you’re really smart.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Yeah, I’m a frickin’ genius.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Leonard, you are so great. Why can’t all guys be like you?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: Because if all guys were like me, the human race couldn’t survive.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm
dialogue: I should probably go.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 06 – The Middle Earth Paradigm

dialogue: Wow, I have to say, you are an amazing man. You’re gentle and passionate, and my God, you are such a good listener!
The apartment, the living room.
Watch this, it’s really cool. Call Leonard Hofstadter.
Did you say, call Helen Boxleitner?
No. Call Leonard Hofstadter.
Did you say, call Temple Beth Sader.
No.
Here, let me try. Call McFlono McFloonyloo. Heh-heh.
Calling Rajesh Koothrappali. (Raj’s phone rings).
Oh, that’s very impressive. And a little racist.
If we’re all through playing mock the flawed technology, can we get on with Halo night, we were supposed to start at eight, it is now 8:06.
So? We’ll start now.
Yes, first we have to decide if those lost six minutes will be coming out of game time, bathroom time or the pizza break.
We can split it two, two and two.
If we’re having anchovies on the pizza we can’t take it out of bathroom time. (There is a knock on the door.)
Oh, what fresh hell is this?
Hey Penny, come on in.
Hey guys.
See a Penny, pick her up, and all the day you’ll have good luck.
No you won’t. Uh, can I hide out here for a while.
Sure. What’s going on.

Well, there’s this girl I know from back in Nebraska, Christie, well anyway she called me up and she’s like “Hey, how’s California,” and I’m like “Awesome” ‘cos, you know, it’s not Nebraska, and the next thing I know she’s invited herself out here to stay with me.

Anyway, she got here today, and she’s just been in my apartment, yakkety-yakking about every guy she’s slept with in Omaha, which is basically every guy in Omaha, and washing the sluttiest collection of underwear you have ever seen in my bathroom sink.
Well, is she doing it one thong at a time, or does she just throw it all in, like some sort of erotic bouillabaisse.
He really needs to dial it down.
So, if you don’t like this Christie, why are you letting her stay?
Well, she was engaged to my cousin while she was sleeping with my brother, so she’s kind of family.
You know, I apologise for my earlier outburst, who needs Halo when we can be regaled with the delightfully folksy tale of the whore of Omaha?
Oh, I don’t think she’s a whore.
No, yeah she’s definitely a whore. I mean, she has absolutely no standards, this one time, she was at… where’s Howard?
Bonjour mademoiselle, I understand you’re new in town.
Oh good grief.
Penny, Sheldon, Raj and Leonard stand in the apartment doorway. Romantic music plays from Penny’s apartment door.
Ugh, I cannot believe Christie let Howard into my apartment.
And I cannot believe people pay for horoscopes, but on a more serious note it’s 8:13 and we’re still not playing Halo.
Okay, fine, we’ll just play one on one until he gets back.
One on one? We don’t play one on one, we play teams, not one on one. One on one!
Well the only way we can play teams at this point is if we cut Raj in half.
Oh, sure, cut the foreigner in half, there’s a billion more where he came from.
Hey, if you guys need a fourth, I’ll play.
Great idea.
Uh, no. The wheel was a great idea. Relativity was a great idea. This is a notion, and a rather sucky one at that.
Why?
Why? Oh, Penny, Penny, Penny.
Oh, what, what, what?
This is a complex battle simulation with a steep learning curve, there are myriad weapons, vehicles and strategies to master, not to mention an extremely intricate back-story.
Oh cool, whose head did I just blow off?
Mine.
Okay, I got this, lock and load boys.
It’s the only way we can play teams.
Yes, but whoever’s her partner will be hamstrung by her lack of experience and not to mention that fact that sh…. (another explosion)
Ha-ha, there goes your head again.
Okay, this isn’t at all good sportsmanship to shoot somebody who’s just respawned, you need to give them a chance to (explosion) now come on!
Raj, Raj, she’s got me cornered, cover me.
Cover this, suckers. Ha-ha-ha!
Penny, you are on fire.
Yeah, so is Sheldon.
Okay, that’s it, I don’t know how, but she is cheating. No-one can be that attractive and be this skilled at a video game.
Wait, wait, Sheldon, come back, you forgot something.
What?
This plasma grenade. (Explosion.) Ha! Look, it’s raining you!
You laugh now, you just wait until you need tech support.
Gosh, he’s kind of a sore loser, isn’t he?
Well, to be fair, he is also a rather unpleasant winner.
Well, it’s been fun.
You know, Penny, we make such a good team, maybe we could enter a couple of Halo tournaments sometime.
Or we could just have a life.
I guess for you that’s an option.
Good night, Leonard.
Good night.
As usual, nice talking to you Raj (leaves.)
What do you suppose she meant by that?
She’s an enigma, Raj.
And another thing, there’s a certain ethic to the game, Penny, a well estab…
She’s gone, Sheldon.
Well she could have said goodbye.
Okay, I have a problem.
It’s called carpal tunnel syndrome, and quite frankly you deserve it.
What’s wrong?
Um, well, Howard and Christie are… kind of… hooking up in my bedroom.
Are you sure?
Look, I grew up on a farm, okay, from what I heard they’re either having sex or Howard’s caught in a milking machine. Do you mind if I stay here tonight?
No, take the couch, or my bed, I just got new pillows, hypo-allergenics.
Uh, the couch is good.
Hold that thought, Leonard, a moment.
Let me guess, you have a problem with this.
Where do I begin?
It’s up to you, crazy person’s choice.
Well first, we don’t have house guests, frankly if I could afford the rent I’d ask you to leave.
Your friendship means a lot to me as well, what else?
Well, our earthquake supplies, we have a two day, two man kit.
So?
So, if there is an earthquake and the three of us are trapped here, we could be out of food by tomorrow afternoon.
I’m sorry, are you suggesting that if we let Penny stay we might succumb to cannibalism?
No-one ever thinks it will happen until it does.
Penny, if you promise not to chew the flesh off our bones while we sleep, you can stay.
Hu.. what?
He’s engaging in reductio-ad-absurdum. It’s the logical fallacy of extending someone’s argument to ridiculous proportions and then criticising the result, and I do not appreciate it.
I’ll get you a blanket and a pillow.
Okay, well since I’m obviously being ignored here, let’s go over the morning schedule, I use the bathroom from 7 to 7:20, plan your ablutions and bodily functions accordingly.
How am I supposed to plan my bodily functions?
I suggest no liquids after 11pm.
Here you go.
Thanks Leonard. (Arranges pillows on left of couch.)
Hmmph, wrong.
I’m listening.
Your head goes on the other end.
Why?
It’s culturally universal, a bed, even a temporary bed, is always oriented with the headboard away from the door. It serves the ancient imperative of protecting oneself against marauders.
I’ll risk it.
Hm!
Anything else I should know.
Yes. If you use my toothbrush I’ll jump out that window. Please don’t come to my funeral. Have a good night.
Sorry about that.
That’s okay.
FYI, his toothbrush is the red one in the plexiglass case under the UV light.
Got it.
Well, sleep tight.
Thanks.
Funny expression, sleep tight. It refers to the early construction of beds which featured a mattress suspended on interlocking ropes which would occasionally… sleep tight.
The following morning. Sheldon is in the kitchen making breakfast. He crosses to the couch, sees Penny sleeping there, looks lost. He is about to sit down on Penny when Leonard enters.
What are you doing?

Every Saturday since we have lived in this apartment, I have awakened at 6:15, poured myself a bowl of cereal, added a quarter cup of 2% milk, sat on this end of this couch, turned on BBC America and watched Doctor Who.
Penny’s still sleeping.
Every Saturday since we have lived in this apartment, I have awakened at 6:15, poured myself a bowl of cereal….
I know, I know, look, you have a TV in your room, why don’t you just have breakfast in bed?
Because I am neither an invalid nor a woman celebrating Mother’s Day.
Uh, what time is it?
Almost 6:30.
I slept all day?
Oh, no, it’s 6:30 in the morning.
What the hell is your problem?
Okay, this cereal has lost all its molecular integrity, I now have a bowl of shredded wheat paste.
Ola, nerd-migos.
Why do you people hate sleep? Are you wearing my robe?
Oh, yeah, sorry, I’ll have it cleaned.
That’s okay, keep it. Where’s Christie.
In the shower. Oh, by the way, where did you get that loofah mitt, yours reaches places that mine just won’t.
Y-you used my loofah?
More precisely we used your loofah. I exfoliated her brains out!
You can keep that too.
Ah, well then we’ll probably need to talk about your stuffed bear collection.
Howard?
In here my lady.
Mmmm, there’s my little engine that could.
chka-chka-chka-chka-chka-chka-chka (they kiss).
Well there’s one beloved children’s book I’ll never read again.
Hi, Christie.
Leonard.
I’m Sheldon.
Right, you’re Howard’s entourage.
Uh, so Christie, what are your plans?
Oh, well, Howard said he’d take me shopping in Beverley Hills.
Yeah, no, I meant plans to find some place to live. Other than with me, not that I don’t love having you, but it’s… a little crowded.
Penny, you’re always welcome to stay with us.
Oh, terrific, now we’re running a cute little B&B.
Let me offer a little outside the box thinking here, why doesn’t Christie stay with me.
For one thing you live with your mother.
I do not, my mother lives with me.

Well then, it’s all settled, Christie will stay with Howard, Penny can go back to her apartment, and I’ll watch the last 24 minutes of Doctor Who, although at this point it’s more like Doctor Why Bother.
Sheldon you just can’t dictate…
No more talking, everybody go.
So, what do you say, you wanna repair to Castle Wolowitz?
What is that, like a Mexican deli?
I’m sorry, I should have mentioned this earlier, my last name is Wolowitz.
Oh, that’s so cool. My first Jew!
I imagine there aren’t many kosher corn-huskers.
But you’re still taking me shopping, right?
Anything you want.
Okay, I’ll go pack my stuff.
When they perfect human cloning I’m going to order twelve of those.
Howard, can’t you see she’s using you?
Who cares, last night she pulled off her blouse and I wept!
Look, Howard, I know her, okay, she’ll have sex with anyone as long as they keep buying her things.
Really?
Yeah.
Yay! If you’ll excuse me, I have some Bar-Mizvah bonds to cash.
A Chinese restaurant.
I’m sorry, we cannot do this without Wolowitz.
We can’t order Chinese food without Wolowitz?
Let me walk you through it, our standard is, the steamed dumpling appetizer, General So’s chicken, beef with broccoli, shrimp with lobster sauce and vegetable lo-main. Do you see the problem?
I see a problem.
Our entire order is predicated on four dumplings and four entrees divided among four people.
So, we’ll just order three entrees.
Fine, what do you want to eliminate, and who gets the extra dumpling.
We could cut it into thirds.
Then it is no longer a dumpling, once you cut it open it is at best a very small open faced sandwich.
Hi fellas. Oh, where’s your annoying little friend who thinks he speaks Mandarin?
He’s putting his needs ahead of the collective good. (Pointing at waiter) Where he comes from, that’s punishable by death.
I come from Sacramento.
Can we get an order of dumplings, but with three instead of four.
No substitutions.
This isn’t a substitution, it’s a reduction.
Okay, no reductions.
Fine, bring us three orders of dumplings, that’s twelve, we’ll each have four.
That works.
No, if we fill up on dumplings we’ll need to eliminate another entree.
No eliminations.
If we have extra, we’ll just take the leftovers home.
And divide it how, I’m telling you we cannot do this without Wolowitz.
Wolowitz is with his new girlfriend, if you had let me invite Penny then you would have had your fourth.
Have you seen Penny eat Chinese food, she uses a fork, and she double dips her egg rolls.
We don’t order egg rolls.
Exactly, but we’d have to if she was here.
Can we please make a decision, not only are there children starving in India, there’s an Indian starving right here.
Here’s an idea, why don’t we just go out for Indian food.
No.
Uurgh.

You are nice boys. Tell you what I’m going to do. I’m going to bring you the four dumplings. When I’m walking over to the table, maybe I get bumped, one of the dumplings falls to the floor, no-one has to know.
I’ll know.
(wanders away cursing in Mandarin.)
How about soup?
Yeah, we can always divide soup.
What about the won-tons?
Outside Penny’s door. Leonard knocks.
Oh, hey guys, what’s up?
It’s Halo night.
Yeah. Okay. So?
Well, with Wolowitz spending all of his time with your friend Christie,
She’s not my friend. Friends do not get their friends care bears all sweaty.
Right, anyway, uh, with Wolowitz occupied elsewhere, we had something we wanted to ask you. Sheldon?
Yes. Penny, we would very much appreciate it if you would be the fourth member of our Halo team. I don’t think I need to tell you what an honour this is.
Oh, that’s so sweet. But I’m going out dancing with a girlfriend.
You can’t go out, it’s Halo night.
Well, for Penny it’s dancing night.
You go dancing every Wednesday.
No.
Then it’s not dancing night.
Look, why don’t I play with you guys tomorrow?
Tonight is Halo night, it’s like talking to a wall.
Alright, now Sheldon, you and I are about to have a problem.
Sheldon, remember, we role-played this.
Yes, but you didn’t portray her as completely irrational.
Alright fellas, I gotta go. Good luck.
Maybe we should have asked if we could go dancing with her and her girlfriend.
Okay, assuming we could dance, which we can’t, there are three of us and two of them.
So?
It’s the Chinese restaurant all over again. I assure you that cutting a dumpling in thirds is child’s play compared with three men, each attempting to dance with 67% of a woman.
Aaah, for God’s sake, Sheldon, you are driving me crazy.
Your anger’s not with me, sir, but with basic mathematics.
No, I’m pretty sure my anger’s with you.
What’s happening to us? We’re falling apart.
Who are you calling?
The only man who can restore any semblance of balance to our universe.
Hi this is Howard Wolowitz.
And this is Christie Van Der Bell.
We can’t get to the phone right now because we’re having sex.
You’re not going to put that on your message are you?
No, I’m just kidding, I’ll re-record it. (beep)
Outside Howard’s house.
Sheldon, think this through, you’re going to ask Howard to choose between sex and Halo.
No, I’m going to ask him to choose between sex and Halo 3. As far as I know, sex has not been upgraded to include high-def graphics and enhanced weapon systems.
You’re right, all sex has is nudity, orgasms and human contact.
My point.
I’m just saying, you can take the damned plastic off the couch once in a while.
Why, so you and Howard can hump on it?
Ladies, ladies, I’m sure there’s a middle ground.
Shut up Howard.
You girl’s talk, I’m going to take my scooter out for a little spin.
Are you happy, you drove your own son out of the house.
Why don’t you stop butting in where you don’t belong.
What are you guys doing here?
It’s Halo night.
He’s not a man, he’s a putz, and don’t you take that tone with me, you gold digger.
What did you call me?
You heard me, and I’ll tell you something else, you’re barking up the wrong tree, cos as long as you’re around, Howard is out of the will.
(voice): You know what, I got better offers, I’m out of here.
That’s right, go back to Babylon, you whore.
So, Halo night, huh?
I thought she was the whore of Omaha?
Shhh!
The apartment, Halo night.
Sheldon, you got him in your sights, fire, he’s charging his plasma rifle.
I can’t shoot now, I’m cloaking.
Now, Raj, kill Sheldon.
I can’t see him.
That’s why the call it cloaking, dead man.
Well then start throwing grenades.
I’m all out.
Hi guys, my friends and I got tired of dancing, so we came over to have sex with you.
That will do, Raj, straight for the tank.
We said no tanks.
There are no rules in hell!
Son of a bitch, medpack, I need a medpack!
Told yah! (They leave).
There’s a sniper, use your rocket launcher.
All I’ve got is a needler, and I’m all out of ammo.
And now you’re out of life. Why did you hit pause?
I thought I heard something.
What?
No, never mind, alright, go.
The Apartment.
Damn you, walletnook.com.
Problem?

The online description was completely misleading, they said eight slots plus removable ID, to any rational person that would mean room for nine cards, but they don’t tell you the removable ID takes up one slot, it’s a nightmare.
Okay, now, do you really need the honorary Justice League of America membership card?
It’s been in every wallet I’ve owned since I was five.
Why?
It says keep this on your person at all times. (Knock on door) It’s right here under Batman’s signature.
And this is Leonard and Sheldon’s apartment.
Guess whose parents just got broadband.
May I present, live from New Delhi, Dr and Mrs V. M. Koothrappali.
Hi.
Lift up the camera. I’m looking at his crotch.
Sorry papa.
Oh, there’s much better. Hi.
Hi!
And over here is Sheldon.
Hi.
He lives with Leonard.
Oh, that’s nice. Like Haroun and Tanweer.
No, no, not like Haroun and Tanweer.
Such sweet young men, they just adopted the cutest little Punjabi baby.
Yeah, we’re not like Haroun and Tanweer!
So are you boys academics like our son?
Yes.
And your parents are comfortable with your limited earning potential?
Not at all.
Papa, please don’t start.
God, it’s just a question, he’s so sensitive.
Okay, that’s my life, that’s my friends, good to see you, say goodbye.
Bye!
Wait, wait. Before you go we have good news. Put the computer down and gather your friends.
What is it papa.
Friends.
Is it just me, or does webchatting with your clothes on seem a little pointless.
Rajesh, do you remember Lalita Gupta?
The little fat girl that used to kick me in the samosas and call me untouchable.
Yes. Well, now she’s a dental student at USC, so we gave her your contact information.
Why did you do that?
You’re 26 years old Rajesh. We want grandchildren.
But Papa, I’m not supposed…
Lalita’s parents approve the match.
If you decide on a spring wedding, we can avoid monsoon season.
Spring wedding?
It’s up to you dear, we don’t want to meddle.
If you don’t want to meddle, then why are you meddling.

If I may, your parents probably don’t consider this meddling, while arranged marriages are no longer the norm, Indian parents continue to have a greater than average involvement in their children’s lives.
Why are you telling me about my own culture?
You seemed confused.
Sorry, Mommy, Papa, but with all due respect I really can’t go through…
Sorry darling, we have to go. Doogie Howser is on. Grandma, it’s Doogie time! Bye bye.
Bye bye.
I don’t believe it.
Neither do I. Doogie Howser’s been off the air for like, twenty years.
Actually, I read somewhere that it’s one of the most popular programmes in India.
It might speak to a cultural aspiration to have one’s children enter the medical profession.
I bet you’re right.
I bet they love Scrubs.
What’s not to love?
Excuse me, hello? My parents are trying to marry me off to a total stranger, what am I going to do?
I suggest you go through with it.
What?
Romantic love as the basis for marriage has only existed since the nineteenth century. Up until then, arranged marriages were the norm, and it served society quite well.
It’s the entire premise of Fiddler on the Roof.
I’m not a big fan of musicals, but I love that show.
Me too. Of course, it speaks to me culturally.
Understandable, but there’s a universality to that story which transcends ethnicity.
Let’s not forget it’s got some really catchy tunes.
(various noises of agreement)
Okay, I know what I’m going to do.
What?
Find new friends.
So who wants to rent Fiddler?
No need, we have the special edition.
Well, maybe we are like Haroun and Tanweer.
The apartment.

This is Dr Sheldon Cooper. Yeah, I need to cancel my membership to the Planetarium. Yeah, well I’m sorry too, but there’s just no room for you in my wallet. Yeah, I understand, but it was between you and the Museum of Natural History and, frankly, you don’t have dinosaurs. Well I’ll miss you too, bye bye. Okay, I know you’re texting about me, and I’d really like you to stop.
Oh dear, I am rightly and truly screwed.
Hey, I thought you were finding new friends.
I’ve got some feelers out. In the meantime, listen to this.
Hi Rajesh, this is Lalita Gupta. Your mother gave my mother your phone number to give to me. So I’m calling you, and, ah… call me back. Bye.
Can you believe how pushy she is?
So don’t call her.
If I don’t call her, I won’t hear the end of it from my parents.
So call her.
How can I call her, you know I can’t talk to women.
I’m done, anybody else?
Give me the phone.
Why?
Just give it to me. (Dials)
What are you doing?

Don’t worry, you’ll thank me. (In a fake Indian accent) Hello Lalita, Raj Koothrappali. (Raj starts to chase Howard across the room.) Yes it is good to talk to you too. So, what are you wearing. Oh, not important, so, anyhow, when would you like to meet. Friday works for me. And I call you with the time and place, but in the meantime, keep it real babe. (In own voice) You may now thank me.
For what, making me sound like a Simpsons character?
Fine, next time make your own date.
I didn’t want to make this one.
Look on the bright side, she might turn out to be a nice, beautiful girl.
Great, then we’ll get married, I won’t be able to talk to her, and we’ll spend the rest of our lives in total silence.
Worked for my parents.
Hi guys.
Oh, hey.
I need some guinea pigs.

Okay, there’s a lab animal supply company in Reseda you could try, but if your research is going to have human applications may I suggest white mice instead, their brain chemistry is far closer to ours.
I swear to God, Sheldon, one day I’m going to get the hang of talking to you.
His mom’s been saying that for years. What’s up?
Well, I finally convinced the restaurant to give me a bar tending shift, so I need to practice making drinks.
Oh, great, well the key to acquiring proficiency in any task is repetition.
With certain obvious exceptions. Suicide, for example.
So Leonard, how about it?

Look, Penny, we’d love to help you, but Raj is going through some stuff right now. And besides, he doesn’t drink, so… (Raj whispers in his ear) Really? Um, Raj is going through some stuff right now and he’d like to take up drinking.
Penny’s apartment.
Okay, here you go, Leonard, one tequila sunrise.
Thank you. This drink is a wonderful example of how liquids with different specific gravities interact in a cylindrical container. Thank you.
Okay, Raj, what’ll it be? (Raj whispers in Leonard’s ear.)
Whatever you recommend.
Uh, how about a grasshopper. I make a mean grasshopper. Okay? Good. Coming up. Sheldon, what are you going to have?
I’ll have a diet coke.
Okay, can you please order a cocktail, I need to practice mixing drinks.
Fine. I’ll have a virgin cuba libre.
That’s, um, rum and coke without the rum.
Yes,
So coke.
Yes. And would you make it diet?
There’s a can in the fridge.
A cuba libre traditionally comes in a tall glass with a lime wedge.
Then swim to Cuba.
Bartenders are supposed to have people skills.
Okay, Raj, here you go. Alright, who’s next?
I’d like to try a slippery nipple.
Okay, you’re cut off. Anybody need a refill?
Where did my life go, Penny? One day I’m a carefree batchelor, and the next I’m married and driving a minivan to peewee cricket matches in suburban New Delhi.
A… are you talking to me?
Is there another Penny here? I had such plans. I had dreams. I was going to be the Indira Gandhi of particle astro-physics. But with a penis, of course.
It’s amazing.

Ever since I was a little boy my father wanted me to be a gynaecologist like him. How can I be a gynaecologist, I can barely look a woman in the eye. You know what, I’m not going to let my parents control my future any longer, it’s time for a showdown. Somebody give me a computer with a webcam.
Okay, sweetie, I think that’s the grasshopper talking.
And it’s about to tell my parents that I’m not riding an elephant down the aisle with Lalita Gupta.
Okay, calm down, no-one can make you get married. Why don’t you just meet this girl and, see what happens.
Haven’t you been listening to me, I cannot talk to women.
Um… Raj.
No, no, let’s see how long it takes him.
Um, Raj, honey, you say you can’t talk to women but… you’ve been talking to me.
And now we’ll never know.
You’re right. I… I am talking to you. Hello Penny, how are you?
I’m fine.
Okay, now I just need to make sure I have a Lalita before I meet the grasshopper. It’s a sweet green miracle.
Okay, if you’re going to drink on this date just promise me you won’t overdo it.
Overdo what? Happiness? Freedom? This warm glow inside of me that promises everything is going to be all hunky donkey?
Yeah, that. Uh, why don’t you bring her to my restaurant when I’m tending the bar so I can keep an eye on you?
Okay.
Wait a minute, what’s the plan here? Let’s say he meets her and he likes her and they get married, what’s he going to do, stay drunk for the rest of his life?
Worked for my parents.
The restaurant.
I can’t believe I’m sitting here next to little Lalita Gupta.
Well, you are.
Little Lalita. That’s kind of fun to say. Little Lalita, Little Lalita, Little Lalita, you should try it.
No, it’s okay.
You have lost so much weight! That must have been difficult for you because you were so, so fat! Do you remember?
Yes, I do.

Shotgun.

How about that.

That is a problem.

Dr Gablehouser.

The apartment.

If he wants to spend a couple of years doing her homework while she drinks herself into a stupor with non-fat White Russians, while you’re the one holding her head out of the toilet while she’s puking and telling you she wishes more guys were like you, and they she gets into Cornell because you wrote her essay for her, and you drive up to visit her one weekend and she acts like she doesn’t even know you.
Okay, so not her either. How about her?
Interesting, kind of pretty, a little chubby so probably low self-esteem.
I think that’s our girl. One of us should go talk to her.
I can’t talk to her, you do it.
I can’t just go up and talk to her. Howard, you talk to her.
Oh no, she’ll never go for the kid once she gets a peek at this.
You know, if we were in India this would be simpler. Five minutes with her dad, twenty goats and a laptop and we’d be done.
Well, we’re not in India.
Alright, why don’t we do it your way then? We’ll arrange for this girl to move in across the hall from Dennis so he can pathetically moon over her for months on end.
Okay, that was uncalled for.
You started it, dude.

Could I have everyone’s attention please. What a wonderful occasion this is. And how fortunate that it should happen to fall on take your daughter to work day. We’re here to welcome Mr Dennis Kim to our little family.
Welcome Dennis Kim.
Mr Kim was not only the valedictorian at Stamford University, he is also the youngest recipient of the prestigious Stephenson Award.
Youngest till the cyborgs rise up!
And now, without any further ado, let me introduce the man of the hour, Mr Dennis Kim. Dennis! Dennis!
What?
Would you like to tell us a little bit about your upcoming research.
Um, no thanks. I’m going to the mall with Emma.
Well, uh, well, uh….
The kid got a girl.
Unbelievable.
Did anyone see how he did it?

Don’t worry, I’ve got this. Ladies and Gentlemen, honoured daughters. While Mr Kim, by virtue of his youth and naivety, has fallen prey to the inexplicable need for human contact, let me step in and assure you that my research will go on uninterrupted, and that social relationships will continue to baffle and repulse me. Thank you.
He’s back.
Yeah, mission accomplished.
Forget the mission, how did that little yutz get a girl on his own?
I guess times have changed since we were young. Smart is the new sexy.
Well, why do we go home alone every night, we’re still smart.
Maybe we’re too smart. So smart it’s offputting.
Yeah, let’s go with that.
The park. The four guys are carrying remote control rockets.
Unbelievable. Components I built are on the International Space Station, and I get a ticket for launching a model rocket in the park.
I don’t know if the ticket was so much for the launch as it was for you telling the policewoman “you have to frisk me, I have a rocket in my pants.”

Hey, look at that. (There is a group of youngsters on the grass, laying about. One is playing a guitar. Dennis Kim is among them. He is drinking something from a bottle in a brown paper bag.) It’s Dennis Kim.
Wow, I almost didn’t recognise him.
You know, I kind of feel bad about what we did to him. (Dennis is now snogging the face off Emma)
Yeah, we really ruined his life.
Screw him, he was weak.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: The apartment. Howard is looking at his mobile phone.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Ooh, more details about the new Star Trek film. There’s going to be a scene depicting Spock’s birth.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: I’d be more interested in a scene depicting Spock’s conception.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Oh, please. For Vulcans, mating, or, if you will, Pon Farr, it’s an extremely private matter.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Still, I’d like to know the details. His mother was human, his father was Vulcan, they couldn’t just conceive.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Maybe they had to go to a clinic. Imagine Spock’s dad in a little room with a copy of pointy ears and shapely rears.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: How come on Star Trek everybody’s private parts are the same. No alien lady ever told Captain Kirk, hey, get your thing out of my nose.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Hi, can you help me, I was writing an email and the A key got stuck. Now it’s just going “aaaaaaa”.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: What did you spill on it?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Nothing. Diet coke. And yoghurt. A little nail polish.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: I’ll take a look at it.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Gentlemen, switching to local nerd news. Fishman, Chen, Chowdry, McNair aren’t fielding a team in the university physics bowl this year.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: You’re kidding, why not?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: They formed a barbershop quartet, and got a gig playing Knotsbury Farm.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Wow, so in your world, you’re like, the cool guys.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Recognise.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: This is our year! With those guys out, the entire physics bowl will kneel before Zod.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Zod?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Kryptonian villain. Long story.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Good story. (Clasps hands to mouth in shock.)

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Well count me out.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: What? Why?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: You want me to use my intelligence in a tawdry competition? Would you ask Picasso to play Pictionary? Would you ask Noah Webster to play Boggle? Would you ask Jacques Cousteau to play Go Fish?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Come on, you need a four person team, we’re four people.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: By that reasoning we should also play bridge, hold up a chuppah and enter the Olympic bobsled competition.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: I want tickets to that please.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Sheldon, what, do I need to quote Spock’s dying words to you.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: No, don’t.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: The needs of the many.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Outweigh the needs of the few.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Or the one. Dammit, I’ll do it.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: The cafeteria.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Okay. First order of physics bowl business. We need a truly kick-ass team name. Suggestions.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: How about the perpetual motion squad? It’s beyond the laws of physics, plus a little heads up for the ladies.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: The ladies?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Perpetual motion squad, we can go all night.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: I like it.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: I don’t. Teams are traditionally named after fierce creatures, thus intimidating ones opponent.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Then we can be the Bengal Tigers.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Poor choice. Gram for gram, no animal exceeds the relative fighting strength of the army ant.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Maybe so. But you can’t incinerate a Bengal Tiger with a magnifying glass.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Let’s put it to a vote. All those in favour….

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Point of order. I move that any vote on team names should be unanimous. No man should be forced to emblazon his chest with the bengal tiger, when common sense dictates it should be an army ant.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Will the gentleman from the great state of denial yield for a question?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: I will yield.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: After we go through the exercise of an annoying series of votes, all of which the gentleman will lose, does he then intend to threaten to quit if he does not get his way?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: He does.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: I move we are the Army Ants, all those in favour?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: The apartment.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Good afternoon, and welcome to today’s physics bowl practice round. I’m Penny, and I’ll be your host, because apparently I didn’t have anything else to do on a Saturday afternoon, and isn’t that just a little sad? Gentlemen, are you ready?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Yes.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Of course.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Fire away. (Raj puts his thumb up.)

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: You know, it’s none of my business, but isn’t a guy who can’t speak in front of women going to hold you back a little?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Oh, uh, he’ll be okay once the women are mixed into the crowd. He only has a problem when they’re one on one and smell nice.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Oh, thanks Raj, it’s vanilla oil.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: I was actually the one who noticed, okay, let’s just start.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Okay, the first question is on the topic of optics. What is the shortest light pulse ever produced? Dr Cooper.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: And of course, the answer is 130 adoseconds.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: That is correct.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: I knew that too.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Good for you, sweetie. Okay, next question. What is the quantum mechanical effect used to encode data on hard disk drives? Howard.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: And of course, the answer is giant magneto resistance.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Right.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Hey, I buzzed in.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: But I answered, it’s called teamwork.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Don’t you think I should answer the engineering questions? I am an engineer.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: By that logic I should answer all the anthropology questions because I’m a mammal.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Just ask another one.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Okay. What artificial satellite has seen glimpses of Einsteins predicted frame dragging? (Raj buzzes.)

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: And of course it’s Gravity Probe B.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Sheldon, you have to let somebody else answer.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Why?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Because it’s polite.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: What do manners have to do with it? This is war. Were the Romans polite when they salted the ground of Carthage to make sure nothing would ever grow again?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Leonard, you said I only had to ask questions.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: The objective of the competition is to give correct answers, if I know them, why shouldn’t I give them?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Some of us might have the correct answers too.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Oh please, you don’t even have a PhD.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Alright, that’s it.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Howard, sit down.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Okay.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: maybe we should take a little break.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Good idea, I need my wrist brace, all this button pushing is aggravating my old Nintendo injury.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: I agree.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: What did he say?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: He compared Sheldon to a disposable feminine cleansing product one might use on a summer’s eve.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Yeah, and the bag it came in.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: The same, later. Sheldon is on his laptop. Leonard enters.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Leonard, excellent, I want to show you something.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Can it wait, I need to talk to you.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Just look. I’ve designed the perfect uniforms for our team. The colours are based on Star Trek, the original series. The three of you will wear support red, and I will wear command gold.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Why do they say AA?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Army Ants.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Isn’t that confusing? AA might mean something else to certain people.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Why would a physics bowl team be called anodised aluminium?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: No, I meant…. never mind. Hey, check it out. I got you a Batman cookie jar!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Oh neat, what’s the occasion?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Well, you’re a friend, and you like Batman, and cookies, and you’re off the team.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: What?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Howard, Raj and I just had a team meeting.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: No you didn’t.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Yes we did, I just came from it.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Okay, I don’t know where you just came from, but it couldn’t have been a team meeting because I’m on the team and I wasn’t there, ergo the team did not meet.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Okay, let me try it this way, uh, I was at a coffee klatch with a couple of friends and one thing led to another and it turns out you’re off the team.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Why?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Because you’re taking all the fun out of it.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Well, I’m sorry, is the winner of the physics bowl the team that has the most fun?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Okay, let me try it this way, you’re annoying and no-one wants to play with you any more.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: I see. Well. At this point I should inform you that I intend to form my own team and destroy the molecular bonds that bind your very matter together, and reduce the resulting particulate chaos to tears.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Thanks for the heads up.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: You’re welcome. One more thing.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Yes.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: It’s on, bitch.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: The cafeteria.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: So who’d he get to be on his team.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: He won’t say. He just smiles, and eats macaroons out of his bat jar.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: He’s using psychological warfare. We must reply in kind. I say we wait until he looks at us, then laugh like, yes, you are a smart and strong competitor, but we are also smart and strong and we have a reasonable chance of defeating you.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: How exactly would that laugh go?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Hee hee hee hee hee hee hee!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: That sounds more like, we are a tall thin woman who wants to make a coat out of your Dalmatians.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Guys, let’s remember that Sheldon is still our friend and my room mate.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: So?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: So nothing, let’s destroy him.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Gentlemen.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Hee hee hee hee hee hee hee!

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Okay, we’re going to need a strong fourth for our team.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: You know who’s apparently very smart, is the girl who played TV’s Blossom. She got a PhD in neuroscience or something.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Raj, we’re not getting TV’s Blossom to join our physics bowl team.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: How about the girl from the Wonder Years?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Gentlemen, I believe I’ve found the solution to all our problems.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: We can’t ask Leslie Winkle.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Why? Because you slept together and when she was done with you she discarded you like last night’s chutney?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Yes.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Sometimes you’ve got to take one for the team.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Yeah. Sack up, dude.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Fine. Here I go, taking one for the team. In the sack. Hey Leslie.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Hi guys.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Leslie, I have a question for you, and it might be a little awkward, you know, given that I…

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Hit that thang.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Leonard, there’s no reason to feel uncomfortable just because we’ve seen each other’s faces and naked bodies contorted in the sweet agony of coitus.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: There’s not? Gee, cos it sure sounds like there should be.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Rest assured that any aspects of our sexual relationship regarding your preferences, your idiosyncrasies, your performance, are still protected by the inherent confidentiality of the bedroom.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: That’s all very comforting, but if it’s okay, I’d like to get on with my question now.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Proceed.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: We are entering the physics bowl and we need a fourth for our team.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: No thanks, I’m really busy with my like sign dilepton super symmetry search.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Dilepton, schmilepton, we need you.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Sorry.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Well, we tried. Just have to face Sheldon mano-e-mano-e-mano. A-mano.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Wait, you’re going up against Sheldon Cooper?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Yes.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: That arrogant, misogynistic East-Texas doorknob that told me I should abandon my work with high energy particles for laundry and child bearing?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: She’s in.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: The Physics Bowl.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: So, how do you feel? Nice and loose? Come to play? Got your game face on? (The guys look confused.) Are you ready?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Oh, yeah. You know you don’t have to stay for the whole thing.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Oh, no, no, I want to. It sounds really interesting.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Gentlemen.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Sheldon.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Sheldon.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Hee hee hee hee hee hee hee hee.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Sheldon. I’m just going to sit down.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: So, is that your team.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Actually, I don’t need a team, I could easily defeat you single-handedly. But the rules require four, so may I introduce, the third floor janitor, he lady from the lunchroom, and, my Spanish is not good, either her son or her butcher. And what about your team? What rat have you recruited to the SS Sinking Ship?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Hello, Sheldon.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Leslie Winkle?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Yeah, Leslie Winkle. The answer to the question, who made Sheldon Cooper cry like a little girl?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Yes, well, I’m polymerised tree sap and you’re non-organic adhesive so, whatever verbal projectile you launch in my direction is reflected off of me, returns on its original trajectory, and adheres to you.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Oh, ouch.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Okay, if everyone could please take your seats.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Here’s your tee-shirt. (Hands her a tee-shirt with PMS on it. Takes jacket off to reveal similar.)

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: PMS? It’s a couple of days early, but…

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: No, it stands for Perpetual Motion Squad.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Oh, right, of course, what was I thinking?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Good afternoon everyone, and welcome to this year’s physics bowl. Today’s preliminary match features two great teams… AA versus PMS.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: All night long, y’all! (Stands and turns round to reveal the back of the tee-shirt which reads “We Can Go All Night”.)

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Okay, well let’s jump right in, first question, for ten points. What is the isospan singlet partner of the Pi Zero Meson? (Buzz) PMS?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: The Eta Meson.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Correct.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: Formal protest.

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture
dialogue: On what grounds?

episode_name: Series 01 Episode 13 – The Bat Jar Conjecture

Uh-huh.

It was a spur of the moment thing, I figured it would go for thousands and I just wanted to be a part of it.
There’s only 30 seconds left in the auction.
Do you have $800?
Not to blow on a miniature time machine.
Don’t worry, the way these things work there’s people waiting ‘til the last second to bid, and then they swoop in and get it, it’s called sniping.
Fifteen seconds.

Why don’t we share it? We’ll each put in two hundred bucks and we’ll take turns having it in our homes.

The apartment living room
