episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Sheldon, you need to work in the morning.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: I know.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Well then, bed mister.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Five more minutes.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Really? You’re going to risk getting sleepy in the middle of your thermodynamic fluctuations seminar? You know what happens when you yawn in public.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Everyone will see my oddly shaped uvula.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: You don’t want that, do you?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: No. But it’s a shame our society mocks the differently uvulated. Who was at the door?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Oh, uh, building manager. They have to fix a pipe so the water will be off tomorrow from noon to two.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: That’s unacceptable. We’re supposed to be given written notice.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: No, no, it doesn’t matter, we’ll be at work.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Well, what if I spill tomato soup on my shirt and have to come home to change, only to find there’s no water for an enzyme soak.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Bifurcated uvula, Sheldon!

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: I’ll have the chicken noodle. Goodnight.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: We’re going to have to be very quiet.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: I know how to get the bucket! I can turn the axe around and use the handle to reach it. Let’s see. Go north. You are in a forest. Go north. You are in a forest. Go north. You are in a forest. Oh dear, I believe I’m lost. Well, I’ll just have to get a fresh start tomorrow.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: No, no, no, no, no. You just need, you just need, you just need to map it out. Come on, I’ll help you. So, uh, you stopped at the stream and you turned north three times?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Yes.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: You’re right, you’re lost, good luck.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Leonard’s bedroom. Morning.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Oh! Leonard, wake up.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Huh! Sorry!

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: For what?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: I don’t know. When I’m in bed with a girl, it’s just, it’s my go to response.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: It’s six o’ clock, I have to get back to Raj’s before he wakes up and realises I’m gone.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Oh, right, sure. I wish you could stay in LA a while longer.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Mmm. Me too.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: You know, I was thinking, there are some great research facilities in India.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Where are you going with this, Leonard?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Well, I’m just saying, I don’t have any real ties here, so if I were to move to New Delhi we could, you know, go out.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Leonard, didn’t we have this conversation five years ago.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Well, yes, but, things have changed, you know, you’re older, I’m older. Look, no more superhero bedsheets.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Sweetheart, just because we have fun when I come to town doesn’t mean I want to have a serious relationship.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: It doesn’t?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Mm-mm. And besides, I could never bring a white boy home to my parents. They’d have a cow. Which is a much bigger deal in India.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: I’m not that white. My great-great grandmother was half Cherokee. I know that’s not the right kind of Indian but it is something.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Aha, you’re funny.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: (Knock, knock, knock) Leonard. (Knock, knock, knock) Leonard. (Knock, knock, knock) Leonard.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: What?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: I heard a woman laughing.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Oh, uh, yeah, I was trying to see if I could laugh as a woman.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Oh. Well, good job, quite convincing. I smell perfume.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Air freshener.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: And is that lipstick on your cheek and neck.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Uh, rash, that’s a bad rash.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: My sympathies. I am no stranger to the crimson scourge that is dermatitis. Can I interest you in a topical steroid from my lotion and unguent collection?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Uh, yeah, yeah, that sounds great.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Very well, I’m sure I can find something that will help you ditch that itch.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Okay, he’s in the bathroom, let’s go.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Do you prefer ointment or cream?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Uh, cream.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: With or without a numbing agent?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Without.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Really? Leonard, there are no heroes when it comes to dermatitis.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Fine. With.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Prescription or non-prescription strength.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Use your best judgement.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Well, I think I have a nice 2009 AnaMantle HC. It’s usually indicated for acutely inflamed haemorrhoids, but it also goes nicely with non mucosal body parts.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Sounds great.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Excellent choice.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Right, right, alright. (They creep almost to the apartment door.)

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Priya?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Good morning, Sheldon.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: For shame, Leonard. For shame. And to think I was ready to waste the last of my good haemorrhoid cream on you.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Leonard’s car.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Making pretty good time, huh?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Is that really what you want to talk about, Leonard?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: No.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: What do you want to talk about?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Please don’t tell anyone I spent the night with Raj’s sister.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: There it is. What if someone asks?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: No-one’s going to ask if I spent the night with Raj’s sister.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Perhaps. But they might ask me something else.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Like what?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Like, has Leonard betrayed any of his friends recently?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Priya and I are both adults. We didn’t betray Raj.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: In fact, you did, but I was referring to Howard.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: What are you talking about?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: April 12th, 2005, Bob’s Big Boy, Toluca Lake. Raj had just introduced us to Priya for the first time, and she was enjoying the sweet taste of Hindu rebellion in the form of a Bob’s Super Big Boy hamburger. In order to preserve your friendship, you and Howard made a pinky swear that neither of you would attempt to woo her. I had a patty melt.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Okay, fine, I betrayed Howard.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: And Raj.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Alright, and Raj.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: And me.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: You?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Violation of the roommate agreement, overnight guest notification clause.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Okay fine, I’m, I’m a horrible human being, I’m the Darth Vader of Pasadena.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: You’re far too short to be Darth Vader. At best you might be a turncoat Ewok.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: My point is, Priya’s gone. And it would be much better if no-one else found out about this.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: You mean, you want me to keep a secret.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Yes.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: You know I can’t keep a secret.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: You can if you try. Think about it this way, if I were Batman and you were Alfred, you’d keep that secret. Right?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Why do you get to be Batman?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Because, well, Batman has the secret.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Well Alfred has secrets too.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Like what?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Alfred knows that Barbara Gordon is Batgirl. Which I’ve now just told to Batman. See, I can’t keep a secret.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Leonard’s lab.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Ta-da!

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: What.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Ta-da. It’s short for da-da-da-da!

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Kind of busy here, Sheldon.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: I know, that’s why I shortened it.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: What do you want.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: I came to go over your alibi for last night.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: What alibi?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: You’ve asked me to lie on your behalf, and as you know, I am deeply uncomfortable with impromptu dishonest, so I’ve provided you with an iron clad alibi. You couldn’t have spent last night with Priya, because you were with another woman.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Oh, I’m so sure I’m going to regret this, but, who was I with?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: The fun loving, and morally loose, Miss Maggie McGeary.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Oh, God.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: You met her at Pasadena’s most popular Irish watering hole, Lucky Baldwin’s, where Maggie spends her nights tending bar, with a head full of curls and a heart full of dreams.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Leonard, call me if you’re interested in coitus. Sincerely, Maggie McGeary.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: And if anyone were to actually call that number they will hear this.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Top of the morning to you. You’ve reached Maggie McGeary. Leave a message after the wee little beep.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: It’s pretty convincing, huh? And it wasn’t even a real person. And here is the clincher. A lock of Maggie’s flaming auburn hair.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Where did you get that?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: From an orang-u-tan in the primate lab.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: An orang-u-tan?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Well, no-one’s going to run a DNA test on it, Leonard, honestly you over-think everything.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Sheldon, I don’t need an alibi. Nobody’s going to ask about last night as long as you just zip your lip. (Sheldon makes lip zipping movement.) Thankyou. Now don’t worry, everything is going to be fine. (Sheldon writes “I doubt it” on Leonard’s whiteboard.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: The cafeteria.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Hey.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Hey, Leonard, will you please tell Howard my sister’s never been attracted to him.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: C’mon Raj, how am I supposed to know who she’s attracted to. Or was attracted to. Or who she might be attracted to. In the future.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: And I have nothing to contribute to this conversation. Because I too know absolutely nothing about Priya’s preferences in male companionship. And with that, I will re-zip my lip.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Hey, so what did you guys think of the new episode of Caprica last night?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: I didn’t see it.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Didn’t see it? What were you doing?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Uh, I was out.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: On Caprica night?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Yeah, I, uh, went for a drink.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Really, you, and where, where did you go?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: To, uh, Lucky Baldwin’s.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Oh, I’ve heard of that place, isn’t that Pasadena’s favourite Irish watering hole.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Yes.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Did you meet anyone interesting there, perhaps a promiscuous redheaded barmaid?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: As a matter of fact I.. I… I can’t… I can’t… I can’t do it.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Sure you can, you’re doing fine, it’s very believable.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Look, I’m sorry Raj, but the truth is I was with Priya last night.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Don’t listen to him, he’s still light headed from all the Irish whiskey and pickled eggs in his system.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: What were you doing with Priya?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: I believe they engaged in coitus but, more importantly, if Leonard had not abandoned his story, would you have found it plausible?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: What? You slept with my sister?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Yeah.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: How could you? We had a pact!

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Excuse me, I think how could you she’s my sister takes precedence over a five year old pinky swear!

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: May I point out, in a parallel universe, your friends are saying Maggie McGeary, she sounds lovely.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Look, I admit it, I may have crossed a line here, but come on, Raj, your sister is a grown woman. To her, I’m a forbidden piece of white chocolate.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: I… I don’t believe it, this is a terrible betrayal of my trust.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: No, no, no, would it help if I told you that I offered her my heart and she kind of stomped on it.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: How hard did she stomp?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Very hard.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Okay, I’m good.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Yeah, well, Raj, I just want to say that I’d never betray your trust. Unlike Leonard, I respect you.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Really?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Mmm.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Was it out of respect that you didn’t tell Raj about the time you dropped his iPhone in a urinal?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Dude! I put that thing on my face!

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: I think a more amusing violation of Raj’s trust is when Howard convinced him that foreigners give presents to Americans on Thanksgiving.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Hey, I didn’t see you giving back your Snoopy snowcone maker.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: That was all a lie? This year’s gifts are already wrapped!

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: And as long as we’re talking about betraying our friends, how about the month Sheldon spent grinding up insects and mixing them into Leonard’s food.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Well, excuse me. That was not a betrayal, that was an experiment to determine at what concentration food starts tasting mothy.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: You put moths in my food?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: For science.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: I can’t believe you kissed my sister with moth mouth.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Well, uh, I can’t believe you used Sheldon’s toothbrush.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: You used my toothbrush?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Not the brush part, just the little rubber thing to pick food from my teeth and massage my gums.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Okay, I, I, I think it’s safe to say that we’ve all done some things we’re not particularly proud of. But come on, we’re friends. Friends overlook each other’s minor lapses. For the record, Howard, I’m sorry that I broke our pact.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Thankyou, and I’m sorry about your phone. And Thanksgiving. And while we’re at it, you don’t have to wash our clothes on the fourth of July.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: As long as we’re apologising, Sheldon, I, I’m sorry I used your toothbrush.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: And I’m sorry. But that behaviour is beyond the pale and cannot be tolerated. We are no longer friends.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: I got you a talking Thomas the Tank Engine for Thanksgiving.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: With real puffing smoke?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Yes.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Alright. But I’m watching you.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: The apartment. Sheldon is making snowcones.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Hey, you got Snoopy out. Can I have a snowcone?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Well, sure.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: These are pretty god, what flavour is this?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Guess.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Papaya?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: No.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Guava?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: You’re so close.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: I give up.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 06 – The Irish Pub Formulation
dialogue: Mango, caterpillar. What are you doing? You said you liked it!
The University Cafeteria.
No, seriously, I think I’ve finally figured out my problem with women.
The capybara is the largest member of the rodent family.
What does that have to do with me and women?
Nothing. It was a desperate attempt to introduce an alternate topic of conversation.

My problem is, I don’t project confidence. So I decided that the next time I meet a woman I think is attractive, rather than holding back and being cautious, I’m going to assume the mantle of self-assurance.
Oh, yeah? What’s that look like?
Hi. I’m Leonard. And you are beautiful. You pop, sparkle and buzz electric. I’m going to pick you up at eight, show you a night you will never forget.
Where are we going?
Good news. I made it onto the team for the new Defence Department laser-equipped surveillance satellite.
Excuse me. If we’re changing topics, I believe I have first dibs with capybara, a rodent the size of a baby hippo.
Congratulations Howard.
Thanks. Listen, I have to get a security clearance, so you guys might be hearing from the FBI.
Whoa, whoa, whoa! I don’t want to speak to the FBI.
Why not?
I’m brown and I talk funny.
They’re just doing a background check on me.
It doesn’t matter. They’ll find a reason to give me a one-way ticket back to Gandhi-ville. By the way, when I say that, it’s not offensive.
Don’t be ridiculous, Raj. You’re here legally.
Nobody cares. Do you know how long it’s been since I got through airport security without being given a colonoscopy?
You know, I try very hard to make our lunch hours educational and informative, but your insistence on talking about your own lives stymies me at every turn.
Fine, Sheldon, tell us about your giant rodents.
No, you squandered your time with me, and the moment has now passed. Feast on your disappointment, much as the capybara feasts on its own waste.
Raj’s apartment. Raj is reading New Moon.
Oh, Bella, don’t you see? Edward’s only pushing you away because he loves you. (Knock on door) Coming.

Dr. Koothrappali? (Raj nods) I’m Special Agent Page, FBI. May I come in? (Nods again) I’d like to talk to you about Howard Wolowitz. (Indicates sofa) Oh, thank you. All right. Well, how long have you known Mr. Wolowitz?
Rum cake?
No, thanks. Now, about Mr. Wolowitz.
Seven years.
I see.
I’m in this country legally, you know.
I’m sure you are. Now, to your knowledge, has Mr. Wolowitz ever committed a crime?
Of course not. I’m here on an H-1B visa, which means I can’t be associated in any way with crime or criminal activity. And I’m not.
Good. To your knowledge, does Mr. Wolowitz have any foreign contacts?
No, just me. Oh, there it is. Here comes a cavity search.
Excuse me?
Please don’t send me back to India, it’s so crowded. It’s like the whole country is one endless Comic-Con, except everybody’s wearing the same costume, Indian Guy.
Dr. Koothrappali, I’m not…
I love this country! The-the baseball, the freedom, the rampant morbid obesity! From California to the New York Island, I’m a real Yankee Doodle boy!
Dr. Koothrappali, please.
My country ’tis of thee, duh duh duh liberty, It’s really great.
Leonard’s lab.
So, when Howard said the FBI would be contacting me, I was expecting Mulder. Glad to see I got Scully.
Who?
Mulder and Scully. X-Files. The truth is out there. Never mind. Uh, so, what would you like to know?
You work with Mr. Wolowitz here at the university, correct?

Yes. Of course, we’re in different departments. He’s an engineer and I’m an experimental physicist. You know, one of those guys who examines the building blocks of creation and says, Hello, maker of the universe, I see what you did there. Good one.
Right. Now, how would you characterize your relationship with Mr. Wolowitz?
Good. It’s a good relationship. Of course, most of my relationships are good. Probably because I exude confidence. People are drawn to that, you know? Confidence, not exuding.
Do you know of any groups Mr. Wolowitz is a member of?
You are beautiful, you know that? You pop, sparkle and buzz electric. I’m going to pick you up at eight, show you a night you will never forget.
Sounds great.
Really?
Yeah. Can my six-foot-two Navy SEAL husband come with us?
Is that, oh, my, I didn’t see the ring with my glasses off, so, look at that, I’m starting to exude.
The apartment. There is a knock on the door.
Want to get that?
Not particularly.
Could you get that?
I suppose I could if I were asked.
Would you please get that?
Of course. Why do you have to make things so complicated?
Dr. Cooper?
Yes.
I’m Special Agent Page, FBI.
You say you’re Special Agent Page, FBI.
Here’s my I.D.
And here is my Justice League membership card. But that doesn’t prove I know Batman.
I just want to ask you a few questions about Howard Wolowitz.
Oh. All right. I doubt anyone would risk the stiff penalties for impersonating a federal officer just to ask questions about a minor league engineer with an unresolved Oedipal complex.
Thank you.
For the record, I truly support the FBI in the mission which is expressed through their motto?
Fidelity, bravery, integrity?

Correct. Now to business. 18 years ago, I sent the FBI Crime Lab samples from a bag of excrement that had been lit on fire on my front porch for fingerprinting and DNA analysis. Why haven’t I heard back yet?
Well, the FBI Crime Lab does have a lot on its plate.
That’s of little comfort to a nation attempting to scrape burning feces off its shoes.
Would you mind if we talked about Mr. Wolowitz now?
A little, but go on.
Thank you. Would you characterize him as responsible?

I’m going to answer that with a visual aid. This is my nine-disc complete Lord of the Rings trilogy blu-ray set.  Mr. Wolowitz borrowed it, damaged plastic retention hub number three, and then returned it to me, hoping I wouldn’t notice. Would you characterize that as responsible?
That’s really not the sort of thing we’re interested in.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Duly noted, Steve from Wichita.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Why am I listed as your executive assistant?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Because the word secretary has fallen into disrepute. FYI, my mother’s birthday is coming up. I’m going to need you to pick up a present.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Okay, we need to stop for a minute.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Leonard, please, we can talk during our break. We have one coming up at midnight. We’ll need snacks.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Sheldon, you’re not in charge. It’s my idea. I’m in charge.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Oh, of course you are. Look at the organizational chart. You’re clearly listed as founder.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Well, yes, and you’re listed as Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer and Chief Operating Officer.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: You missed Chief Science Officer, Chairman of the Board, and Head of the Secret Santa Committee.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Okay. You need to get clear on this right now. I am in charge of this project.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Ooh. Leonard’s going all alpha nerd on Sheldon’s ass.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: All right. All right, I’m not going to argue with you. Sheldon Cooper is nothing if not a team player. Dr. Hofstadter, you have the conn.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Thank you. I thought we might start by talking about the user interface.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Oh, dear Lord, we’re doomed.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Later.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: So this button here will allow you to scan a new equation, but over here, you can press this, and just substitute new values for the coefficients.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Good one, boss.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: What?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: This diagram. I assume you were opening with a joke. It certainly buoyed up this employee’s esprit de corps.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: It’s not a joke. It’s the real design.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: In that case, may I offer 27 little tweaks to make it slightly less embarrassing?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Sheldon, I think this will work. Let’s just try it my way.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Oh, I’m, I’m sorry. I assumed that you wanted candid truth-telling from your employees, but I realize now, you want the mindless nattering of complacent yes-men.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Are you done?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: If you say so, boss.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Later still.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: So right now, this button-press event is just triggering a dummy procedure call…

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: How about this for the app name? The Surprisingly Helpful Equation-Linked Differential Optimized Numerator.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: So it spells Sheldon?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Does it? A happy accident.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: We’re not doing names now. Howard?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Like I was saying, right now it’s just a dummy procedure, but eventually, it will drop us into…

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: All right, fine. If we’re not going to give it a name, can we at least give it a secret code designation?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: No.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Well, but hear me out. The atomic bomb was The Manhattan Project. Windows 95 was originally Project Chicago. For our app, I would humbly suggest Project Nodlehs.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: That’s just Sheldon backwards.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Another happy accident.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: We’re not wasting time with names right now.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: I see. Is that decision open for discussion?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: No.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Is the decision to not discuss it open for discussion?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: No.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Again, right now it’s just a dummy procedure, but eventually, it will drop us into…

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: I call for a vote of no confidence and an immediate change in leadership.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Oh Sheldon, stop it.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: When in the course of human events, it becomes necessary to dissolve the bonds that tie three competent scientists together…

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: That’s enough, Sheldon.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: All right, let’s get right to the vote. Show of hands all those opposed to Leonard and his reign of tyranny.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Okay, that’s it, you’re fired.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Really? Why?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Because you’re impossible to work with.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: I see. And is that open for discussion?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: The following morning.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: What are you doing?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Oh. Good morning, shoemaker. I think you’ll be pleased with what the elves were up to last night.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: But I fired you.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Oh, I know. I’m now an independent contractor.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: No, you are now nothing. You have no connection to this project whatsoever.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: But I made it better.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: I don’t want it better. I want it my way.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Well, that speaks volumes, doesn’t it? All right, I suppose I’ll go put on my bus pants.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: What the hell are bus pants?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: They are pants one wears over one’s regular pants when one sits on bus seats that other people have previously sat on. But perhaps from your lofty heights atop the corporate ladder, you’ve lost touch with the struggles of the common man.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Look, I’m still happy to drive you to work. Nothing’s changed in that regard. We’re still roommates, we’re still friends.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Except you identified me, your best friend, as a gangrenous limb that needed to be severed from the organism and tossed away. The desperate act of a little man with a big Napoleon complex.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: You know what? Go put on your bus pants.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: The cafeteria.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Mm. Last night, I had a dream we got so rich from the app, you and I bought matching side-by-side mansions. But there was a secret tunnel connecting your front yard to my back yard. What do you think that means?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: It means after we play handball, I’m showering at home.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Good morning, Friend Howard. Friend Raj. I see you gentlemen are enjoying beverages. Perhaps they would taste better out of these.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: World’s Greatest Astrophysicist?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Don’t thank me. You earned it.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Howard Wolowitz. Why not World’s Greatest Engineer?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: I’m sorry. I typed that into the label maker, but I just couldn’t press enter. Now down to business. What would it take for you to abandon Leonard and join me in a rival company? Unless, of course, the mugs are sufficient, in which case, welcome aboard.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: We’re not quitting on Leonard.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: I understand. And your loyalty is admirable. But what if I were to up the ante?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: What are you talking about?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Monogrammed key chains with a built-in laser pointer. No? How about can cosies emblazoned with our university mascot? Go, Beavers. I’ll be back.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: The apartment.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Okay, let’s try this one. Spherical Hankel function.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Hold on. That’s it!

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Eureka!

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Hey, we agreed when it was Eureka time, we were all gonna say it together.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Fine. Let’s say it together.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: No. The moment has passed.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Greetings, gentlemen. How goes your little project?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: You mean, Project Lenwoloppali?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Ah, a combination of all your names. Very clever. I assume Koothranardowitz was taken?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: We’re actually scanning equations and getting good results.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Oh, well then, by all means, carry on. I wouldn’t want to impede your progress.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Howard, did you solve the install time problem yet?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: No. It’s a little tricky. I’m gonna try having it pick up the libraries dynam…

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: What are you doing?!

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Playing the theremin.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: No. I mean, what are you doing with a theremin?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Playing it. I’ve loved the theremin from the first moment I heard the original Star Trek theme. And it’s been killing me that it just sits in my closet, gathering dust.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Sheldon! We’re working here!

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: That’s all right. I can barely hear you over my theremin. (Leonard pulls out plug) Well, that was a little uncalled for.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: No, that was completely called for. We need quiet.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: So, your project is more important than mine?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Well, seeing as your project is to sabotage my project, yes.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Don’t beat around the bush, Leonard. If you don’t want me here, just say the word, and I’ll leave.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: The hallway.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Could have beaten around the bush a little.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: The lobby. Sheldon is playing his theramin.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Nobody knows the trouble I’ve seen, nobody knows my sorrow-ow-ow-ow.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: What you doing? Trying to contact your home planet?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: I’m practicing my theremin.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Oh.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Nobody knows the trouble I’ve seen. Glory, hallelujah.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Something got you down, there, Sheldon?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Leonard kicked me out of my own apartment. And his app team.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Oh, honey, I’m sorry.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: He wouldn’t drive me to work today. I had to wear my bus pants.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Is that so?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Yes. And they’re still sticky.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Aw.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Probably going to have to throw them away.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Hey, you don’t need Leonard and his app. You can make one with me.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: With you?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Seriously, I have a great idea for one.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Is it better than your idea to move to Los Angeles and become a famous actress?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Okay, look, when you see someone wearing shoes you like, you just snap a picture of them, and the app goes on the Internet to find out where you can buy them.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: That’s your app idea?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Well, you don’t like it?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: I didn’t say that. But no, I don’t.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Why not?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Oh, Penny, where do I begin? The simple-mindedness of your idea is exceeded only by its crass consumerism and banality.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: And Leonard didn’t want to work with you? Imagine that.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: I know, it’s baffling. (Singing) Nobody knows the trouble I’ve seen.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Sheldon, I’m gonna make some cocoa. Do you want some?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Do you make it with milk or water?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Milk.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Real cocoa?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: That’s what it says on the packet.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Do you have those little marshmallows?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: No, sorry.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Well, I suppose it’s appropriate.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: What does that mean?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: A disappointing drink for a disappointing day.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: The apartment.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Hey, look at this. 20 people from the university have already signed up for our private beta.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: I’m telling you, the Lenwoloppali Differential Equation Scanner meets a real need. We’ve got a hit.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: What do you think we should sell it for?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Well, based on the fact that our potential market is about 70 or 80 guys, and you want a submarine, I’d say about a million dollars a pop.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Well, what if we put out a lite version for half a million? You know, get the word of mouth going.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Hi. I’m sorry to bother you guys, but you’ve got to come take your Sheldon back.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: What’s he doing in your apartment?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Well, he was moping down in the lobby, so I invited him over, and now I regret it.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Why do you regret, uh, never mind, stupid question.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Look, can’t you just let him play with you until bedtime?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: We’re not playing. This is real work.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: We’re going to be hundred-aires.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Okay. What if I got him to apologize and promise to behave?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Then I guess we would let him back on the app team, and while we’re doing that, you could take an aerial tour of L.A. on your flying pig.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Okay. Wait right here.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: I’ll tell you one thing. If I get rich enough, that’s the kind of girl I want to take on a submarine ride. And yes, that time, I meant it to be dirty.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Penny’s apartment.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Really? Leonard wants me back?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Oh, yes. He says they are lost without you.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Well, we sure saw that coming.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: That’s right.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: You know what I’m going to do? I am going to sit here and just let them stew.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: No, no, no. You know, they have suffered enough. Everybody’s suffered enough. The thing is, you’re going to have to offer him a face-saving way out of this.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: How?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Say you’re sorry.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Oh, no. Mrs. Mary Cooper didn’t raise her no liars.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Okay. Um, how about this? You know how you’re always trying to learn about sarcasm?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: No.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: No?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: I was being sarcastic.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Oh. Good for you. So all you have to do here is say you’re sorry to Leonard, but say it sarcastically.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Of course. He will hear it as an attempt to mend fences, as opposed to the withering condemnation you and I will know it to be.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Yeah. Yeah, that was my plan. All right. Come on. Let’s go.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Oh, by the way, thank you for the delicious cocoa.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Oh, you’re welcome.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Boy, I’m getting good at this.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: The apartment.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Okay, now that you’re back on the team, let’s get you caught up.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Before you begin, let me say again how deeply sorry I am for my earlier behaviour and how much I respect and admire your leadership.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Thank you. So as you can see, not only can you store your favourite equations, but you can forward them to your friends or post them on Facebook right from the app.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Well, I must say, I am impressed.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Thanks.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: You all have clearly put in a lot of hard work.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: We have.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: As a result, you have taken the most important step on the road to success, learning what not to do. Now, let’s start fresh. Howard, we’re going to need some tea.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Penny’s apartment.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Okay, these are Uggs. These are Crocs. These are knockoff Manolo Blahniks.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Bored.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Look, you said it yourself, we have to create a database before you can write an alga-thingy.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Algorithm. You see, Penny, Alan Turing defined an algorithm…

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Bored. Okay. These are Steve Maddens. These are Nine West. These are Target. Oh, but don’t they look like Chanel? These are Michael Kors. These are Roxy. These are Sachel’s. Oh, these are Betsy Johnson, they’re so cute…

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 12 – The Bus Pants Utilization
dialogue: Nobody knows the trouble I’ve seen, nobody knows my sorrow…

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 13 – The Love Car Displacement
dialogue: The Cheesecake Factory

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 13 – The Love Car Displacement
dialogue: Hey. So you guys ready to order?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 13 – The Love Car Displacement
dialogue: Since we come in every Tuesday night at six o’clock and order the same exact thing, and it’s now six oh eight, I believe your question not only answers itself but also stands alongside such other nonsensical queries as who let the dogs out? and, uh, How are they hanging?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 13 – The Love Car Displacement
dialogue: Okay. So, the usual, with extra spit on Sheldon’s hamburger.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 13 – The Love Car Displacement
dialogue: Penny, a moment? Do you have plans this weekend?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 13 – The Love Car Displacement
dialogue: Oh, gee, Amy, I’m sorry, I’m actually pretty busy this weekend.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 13 – The Love Car Displacement
dialogue: Probably serving food that was ordered today.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 13 – The Love Car Displacement
dialogue: That’s too bad. I was hoping you could be my plus-one at the Institute of Interdisciplinary Studies’ symposium on the impact of current scientific research on societal interactions.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 13 – The Love Car Displacement
dialogue: The what?

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 13 – The Love Car Displacement
dialogue: It’s an annual science conference. We’ve all been invited to speak.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 13 – The Love Car Displacement
dialogue: Oh. Oh, okay, well, you know, like I said, I have plans, so.

episode_name: Series 04 Episode 13 – The Love Car Displacement

Coming.

Leonard’s car.
